descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to orchestrate the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Senior Sourcing Manager in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will be a key part of our APAC sourcing operations. You will lead end-to-end sourcing projects, mentor a rising team of Sourcing Managers, and serve as a key advisor to executive leadership. If you thrive on complexity and want to feel a direct impact on the delivery of life-saving diagnostics to patients worldwide, this is where you belong.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Sourcing Lead APAC and is part of
the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will be part of a regional team of Senior Sourcing Managers and Sourcing Managers, managing relationships with other DOP stakeholders (Category, Delivery) as well as external suppliers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor with responsibilities to mentor junior team members.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics - including PPV savings, preferred supplier share, and shortened cycle times - to deliver bottom-line value while tracking stakeholder satisfaction.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and NPI benchmarking in close collaboration with Category and NPI managers.

• Contract & Document Management: Setting up and reviewing high-complexity contracts (e.g., MSAs) and purchasing documentation, while accurately managing their lifecycle repository and renewals.

• Operational Excellence & SME Leadership: Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to simplify workflows, analyze site user requirements for best-value methods, and ensure strict compliance with global policies.

• Bottleneck Resolution & CSR: Partnering with support functions like Accounts Payable (AP) to clear supplier-related administrative bottlenecks, while championing supply base CSR initiatives (diversity, sustainability, ethical practices).

• Conflict & Exposure: Managing high-stakes conflicts regarding competing project priorities or supplier selections, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to the CoE LT and DPLT.

Who you are
We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can embrace collaboration, provide direction and mentor colleagues across different locations.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or equivalent and professional certifications (e.g., CIPS, ISM) are desirable.

• Experience: 5-7+ years of experience in sourcing and end-to-end contract management. You have a proven track record of driving procurement projects (e.g., cost-reduction initiatives and value-improvement programs).

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to architect the overarching global procurement strategy and command the end-to-end supplier networks for the electronic components that power our next-generation diagnostic devices? As our Global Category Manager for e-Components in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this critical spend category. In this role, you will manage top-tier electronic component suppliers, navigate global supply chain complexities, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of global electronics supply markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Emploi
• En tant que chef de file du chapitre sur la commercialisation, vous serez chargé de diriger, de surveiller et d'élaborer des stratégies de commercialisation approfondies afin d'ajouter une amélioration et une valeur continues aux patients, d'établir un partenariat commercial avec les intervenants externes et d'accélérer l'accès des patients.
• En tant que chef de chapitre, vous agirez comme un leader agile (Visionnaire, Architecte, Coach, Catalyst) et vous assurerez que tous les membres du chapitre vivent Roche Taiwan. Vous êtes passionné par notre concentration sur les personnes et la culture, nos clients externes, l'accès des patients et la durabilité des soins de santé à long terme à Taiwan.
• Vous serez le catalyseur et le modèle pour diriger l'équipe, élever le niveau de la capacité de marketing à l'ère de l'IA pour favoriser l'excellence de la commercialisation.
• Vous serez le catalyseur pour contribuer au réseau à l'intérieur et au-delà de Taiwan. Vous mettez toujours les patients au centre de nos opérations et vous assurez que tout ce que nous faisons bénéficiera durablement aux patients et apportera de la valeur à notre société et à l'entreprise. Portée du rôle
• Agir en tant que chef de file VACC (Visionnaire, Architecte, Catalyste, Coach) qui permet aux individus et aux équipes de se développer et de croître en fonction de leur passion et des besoins de l'organisation
• Élaborer un cadre pour s'assurer que les membres du chapitre sont des experts en marketing et sont compétents pour :
• Crée et favorise un esprit d'équipe fort et prend le rôle de « champion stratégique de produits ».
• Dirige l'élaboration de la stratégie de commercialisation locale (ou au-dessus de l'affiliation).
• Démarre et coordonne le processus de développement et d'évolution de l'image de marque.
• Maintenir une connaissance à jour du marché mondial de la zone thérapeutique.
• Surveille l'activité des concurrents et recommande des mesures.
• Cultiver et développer des leaders d'opinion clés, des défenseurs de produits et des intervenants.
• Examiner, approuver et surveiller le budget.
• Apporte sa contribution à la stratégie de relations publiques et d'accès.
• Assure la présentation des prévisions, le niveau des stocks et la saisonnalité des coûts
• Assurer le développement des stratégies de marketing et leur exécution avec une forte concentration de la valeur du patient et lié à toutes les stratégies et solutions générées par différentes fonctions et équipes
• Diriger les activités commerciales de soutien des zones de dédicat et de maladie
• Catalysez la manière de travailler en réseau: le t eam à w ork en tant que partenaires avec d'autres chapitres/ clusters w ithi n et au-delà de la relation
• Assurer la fluidité des ressources et des talents pour atteindre les résultats des filiales
• Soutenir l'équipe d'APAC pour le développement des gens des marketeurs APAC à Taiwan Exigences Qualifications : Bon bilan de conformité. Aucune violation de la conformité n'a été décelée au cours des cinq dernières années. Éducation: Minimum: Baccalauréat en sciences, en économie ou en affaires. Un diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie et/ou MBA est un plus. Expérience professionnelle :
• Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits pharmaceutiques ou d'expérience équivalente, et plus de 8 ans d'expérience en fonction commerciale
• Démontrer la capacité à atteindre ou dépasser les objectifs de vente et de commercialisation
• Excellente maîtrise de la planification et de la gestion du déploiement des ressources
• Expérience dans la conduite d'équipes interfonctionnelles ou de marketing réalisant des objectifs ambitieux
• L'expérience de travail dans une organisation qui a adopté des méthodes et des méthodes de travail agiles serait un avantage important Compétences et connaissances :
• Bonne connaissance des exigences de conformité et compréhension claire des normes élevées d'intégrité
• Capacité à diriger le thé

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
岗位名称：实习医药信息顾问

职位职责：
• （1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3） 协助 开展学术会议，协助带教人员向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （1）在校大学生
• （2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Partner per gli Affari Medici, agirai come collaboratore affidabile, esterno, e scientificamente fondato all'interno del nostro ecosistema di coinvolgimento dei clienti. Con sede nel team di affiliazione, guiderai la strategia medica locale, costruirai profonde connessioni peer-to-peer con le comunità scientifiche, e garantire che le nostre innovazioni diagnostiche e terapeutiche raggiungano il loro pieno potenziale per trasformare la vita dei pazienti. In questo ruolo, voi:
• Guida Scientific & Medical Strategy: Guida la componente medica della strategia terapeutica integrata, traducendo i dati clinici complessi in una chiara e differenziata storia del valore in aree chiave della malattia.
• Coltivare Partenariati Fiduciati: impegnarsi attivamente con Leader del parere chiave (KOL), esperti scientifici esterni e stakeholder sanitari per promuovere collaborazioni significative e guidate dalla scienza.
• Advance Evidence Generation: Sviluppare e implementare piani di prova integrati locali, identificare lacune di dati e sostenere studi Real-World Evidence (RWE), studi non-intervenzionali e ricerche avviate da ricercatori.
• Accelerare l'accesso al mercato dei pazienti: Contribuisci competenze scientifiche alle sottomissioni di Health Technology Assessment (HTA), articolando il valore reale delle nostre innovazioni per garantire un accesso più rapido ai pazienti.
• Lead Digital & Ecosystem Innovation: raccoglie sistematicamente intuizioni cliniche esterne, utilizzando strumenti digitali emergenti e approfondimenti AI responsabilmente per anticipare e ottimizzare l'adozione della pratica medica locale.
• Assicurare l'assoluta Eccellenza e conformità: supervisionare le richieste di informazioni mediche e collaborare con i team di Operazioni Regolatorie e Cliniche, mantenendo una stretta adesione alle normative del settore, agli standard etici e alla buona prassi clinica (GCP). Chi sei Sei un professionista imprenditoriale, orientato alla soluzione che prospera in ambienti di team interfunzionali. Equilibrare profonda esperienza scientifica con l'acume strategico necessario per navigare ambiguità e comunicare intuizioni complesse con chiarezza e impatto. Le tue qualifiche:

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste hautement qualifié en gestion de données et gouvernance pour exécuter notre stratégie de migration de données de bout en bout, en assurant une transition transparente, précise et sécurisée de systèmes existants complexes à notre colonne vertébrale numérique future. Le rôle : ce que vous ferez Dans cette position au niveau de l'entreprise, vous comblerez l'écart entre l'ingénierie des données techniques et les objectifs commerciaux stratégiques. Vous naviguerez dans des structures complexes de données existantes, gérerez des plates-formes de gouvernance de données à grande échelle et vous assurerez que les données migrées prennent parfaitement en charge les opérations mondiales. Vos responsabilités principales comprendront :
• Exécution de la stratégie de migration : Diriger la conception et l'exécution de cadres, de politiques et de processus complets de migration des données pour assurer une transition harmonieuse des données héritées dans le nouvel environnement ERP.
• Gouvernance et conformité avancées : Concevoir, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des cadres avancés de gouvernance des données au niveau de l'entreprise qui s'étendent à l'ensemble de l'organisation, assurant des pratiques de conformité des données solides.
• Résoudre les problèmes complexes : Tâcher des anomalies et des anomalies de migration des données très complexes, effectuer une analyse racine-cause pour protéger l'intégrité des données de l'entreprise.
• Profil et qualité des données: Établir des mesures rigoureuses de qualité des données, des normes de validation, des routines de nettoyage et des méthodologies de profilage pour assurer une migration à haute fidélité.
• Cible de cartographie des données : Analyser les architectures de données existantes, très fragmentées, et les cartographier proprement aux modèles de données ERP cibles futurs.
• Alignement des intervenants principaux : Agir en tant que conseiller stratégique clé, assurer la liaison directe avec les cadres supérieurs, les propriétaires d'entreprises fonctionnels et les fournisseurs externes afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie de migration et de traduire les risques liés aux données techniques en impacts opérationnels clairs.
• Leadership d'équipe et mentorat : Guider, diriger et mentorer les jeunes spécialistes et les équipes interfonctionnelles, favoriser un environnement collaboratif et performant. Ce que vous apporterez à l'équipe Expérience et contexte
• Expérience approfondie: Une expérience éprouvée de projets de migration de données à cycle complet pour les grandes plates-formes ERP et l'amélioration continue des cadres de migration complexes.
• Impact de la gouvernance : Succès démontré à l'origine de projets de gouvernance des données à impact élevé qui façonnent avec succès les politiques globales en matière de données organisationnelles et les stratégies opérationnelles à long terme .
• Collaboration Matrix : Expérience en collaboration avec des équipes techniques, des chefs d'entreprise et des consultants externes au sein d'une organisation mondiale en évolution rapide. Compétences techniques et artisanat
• Expertise en matière d'outillage : Maîtrise technique reconnue dans les outils de migration de données standard et ETL.
• Nettoyage et profilage des données: Capacités avancées en profilage des données, validation structurelle et nettoyage des données complexes pour atteindre l'hygiène absolue des données.
• Modélisation des données: Capacité exceptionnelle de déconstruire les systèmes existants et de les traduire en configurations cibles propres et structurées. Leadership et communication
• Présence de la haute direction : compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des intervenants et en conseil, orientation confortable des cadres supérieurs à travers la stratégie de gouvernance décis

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

• Roche Diagnostics Pakistan is looking for a Product Manager, internally titled as Manager Business Innovation Molecular. Reporting to the Team Lead- Business Innovation, this position will see you developing specific marketing plans for products within the organization, interprets and translate scientific clinical data into commercial implications. You will analyze data and make strategic recommendations while providing marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches.

• This is a permanent and individual contributor position based in Karachi, within our Diagnostics business.

Your Opportunity

• Conceptualize, lead, execute and/or coordinate all activities related to product launches, product promotions, scientific training and for the Sales team, Customer & market analyses, co-creation and implementation of marketing plans and management of allocated A& P budget.

• Co-create with Medical, Sales teams, Clinical Value Marketing promotional, educational, access and partnership initiatives or business model solutions, which support faster adoption of Diagnostics solutions according to clinical guidelines and protocols

• Co-develop the marketing plan based on robust market insights and analytics and informed by regular key Customer visits with Medical & Sales

• Leverage globally developed campaigns and brand assets to deploy locally translated promotional/educational materials for new and existing products, including brochures, leaflets, detailing materials, presentations, Lead HCP and Institutional marketing efforts for product promotion. including disease education

• Maintain strong disease and product knowledge; support internal and external customer education programs and product training

• Lead KOL engagement and speaker programs

• Leverage Medical and Scientific studies to create content for patients, HCPs and Institutions

• Drive shift in engaging HCPs on digital marketing platforms

• Coordinate with Medical to establish relevant presence and engagement for strategic events (symposia, conferences, etc.)

• Contribute to actionable training & progress of the Sales Team by feedback & feed forward and sharing Customer Insight

• Implement Globally developed/validated tools and assets, customized for local use as applicable

• Track and consolidate relevant analytics and ROI KPIs

• Adopt

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Functional expertise – Primary Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Play the role of “strategic product champion” to lead the development of the local (or above affiliate) marketing strategy and drive/coordinate branding development or evolution process

• Ensure the development of the marketing strategies and their execution with a strong focus of patient value and connected with all the strategies and solutions generated by different functions and teams

• Design and deliver delightful end-to-end customer experiences through networked way of working

• Maintain up to date knowledge of the global market for the therapy area

• Use appropriate data analytics: analyze and assesses the data to extrapolate meaning and opportunities that drives the product’s overall market strength and positioning

• Enable a wide range of tactical activities to support a seamless, well integrated brand message and overall position across multiple marketing platforms. These activities may span several customer types (e.g. payers, HCPs) and will require working knowledge across different types of marketing

• Monitor competitor activity and recommend action

• Cultivate and develop Key Opinion Leaders, product advocates and speakers Ensure that all products are actively forecasted; manage the introduction/withdrawal of products; and that product changes/updates are communicated

• Provide input into public relations and access strategy Respect the compliance with all relevant Roche guidelines and policies

Mindset & Behaviors

• Enterprise thinking, eager to learn, system thinker, self-managed & directed, bold, and being able to prioritize

• VACC mindset

• The ability to work with cross-functional teams is a must

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools

• Embracing & implementing agile ways of working is a must

• Entrepreneurial mindset with good partnering capabilities (ability to deeply listen, question & understand, communicate smoothly)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, takes risks and experiments, embrace challenges and failures, and contributes to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside Roche

Operating Principles

• Put Patients First: I always act as if patients I know are in the room and do what's best for them

• Follow the science: I seek answers through experiments, data and debate, and act on facts

• Act as one team: I care, collaborate and commit without boundaries, and trust others to do their part

• Embrace differences: I seek diverse perspectives, invite opposing views, and challenge myself and others

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior DevOps Automation Engineer The Patient Software Insights group within Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is responsible for a portfolio of software solutions that support healthcare providers and patients across various applications and disease areas. For a quick look at what we do, check out Roche tech4life . The Opportunity: Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk! You will oversee application releases and manage the automation process to support building our applications. Tasks may include scripting, testing, troubleshooting problems, and communicating issues to software engineers. Who you are: We seek an experienced, motivated Senior DevOps Software Engineer who will work closely with engineers and our product teams. Required skills to accomplish your mission:
• At least 7 years of hands-on experience automating CI/CD pipelines (for example, Backend, Web, API, Lambdas, and Desktop (Windows, MacOS)).
• Proven ability to establish code branching and review processes.
• Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language.
• Deep experience in:
• Setting up and maintaining CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
• Building containers (Containerd, Docker).
• Managing artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory).
• Integrating SAST and DAST security tools (SonarQube, Mayhem, Trivy).
• A real enthusiasm for teamwork and helping others across different teams.
• A desire to mentor colleagues and share your knowledge.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. The following skills significantly strengthen your application:
• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud platforms.
• Experience in building and testing applications (e.g., JMeter, Appium, xCUITest, JUnit, Selenium),
• Background in developing digital products such as SaaS, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms.
• Knowledge of the diabetes or similar healthcare industries. Here's what you can expect from us:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• We welcome technical evangelists, so if you are interested in any thought leadership contributions (blogs, conferences) within the realm of the organization, we are happy to support you.
• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget,...) You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits. You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcare systems worldwide. Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you!

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Information Solutions (RIS) , we believe that every line of code can improve a patient’s life. Within our Patient Software Insights group, we build a diverse portfolio of digital solutions—from web apps to desktop tools—that help healthcare providers and patients stay one step ahead of disease.
We don't just "deploy"; we deliver trust.
As a Senior DevOps Automation Engineer , you will be the guardian of our delivery lifecycle, ensuring that our life-saving software reaches those who need it with the highest quality and security.

The Opportunity: Where Engineering meets Purpose
Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is life-changing. You will join a cross-functional squad of brilliant engineers, designers, and product owners to:

• Master the Pipeline: Architect and oversee complex CI/CD ecosystems for Backend, Web, API, and Desktop environments (Windows/MacOS).

• Define the Standard: Establish best-in-class code branching and review processes that empower our dev teams.

• Automation at Scale: Use your Python mastery to eliminate manual bottlenecks and create self-healing deployment flows.

• Security & Resilience: Integrate cutting-edge SAST/DAST tools (SonarQube, Mayhem) to ensure our medical software is impenetrable.

• Lead by Example: Mentor fellow engineers and act as a technical lighthouse within the organization.

Who You Are: The Architect of Flow
You are a seasoned engineer who sees the "big picture." You are passionate about clean code, robust infrastructure, and, above all, the people you work with.
Your technical footprint:

• Proven Track Record: 7+ years of hands-on experience in high-level CI/CD automation across diverse platforms (Web, API, Lambdas, Desktop).

• The CI/CD Trio: Deep expertise in GitHub Actions , Jenkins, or GitLab CI.

• Containerization & Repos: Master of Docker/Containerd and artifact management (Nexus/Artifactory).

• The Language of Automation: Proficiency in Python (or a similar high-level language).

• Security-Minded: Experience weaving security tools (Trivy, SonarQube) into the fabric of the development process.

• Soft Skills: A collaborative spirit, a desire to mentor, and excellent English communication skills.

You’ll stand out if you bring: Familiarity with AWS, experience with testing frameworks (Appium, Selenium, JUnit), or a background in SaaS/E-commerce.

What’s in it for you? (The Roche Experience)

• Work with Purpose: Direct contact with our users to understand how your work helps people living with diabetes and other conditions.

• Innovation Culture: We welcome "technical evangelists." If you want to speak at a conference or write a blog, we’ll support you 100%.

• State-of-the-Art Tech: From native development to Infrastructure-as-Code in the cloud.

• Premium Benefits: Brand new Apple hardware, professional training budget, fitness and lunch benefits, public transport support, and language classes.

• A Hub of Talent: Join a diverse, agile environment in Sant Cugat where knowledge sharing is part of our DNA.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Business Architect, definirete e manterrete la visione architettonica e la strategia per l’organizzazione Roche, garantendo l’allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e sostenendo l’adozione e l’implementazione dell’Architettura di riferimento di Roche. Essendo l'autorità e il tutore dell'Architettura di riferimento, creerai soluzioni complete, promuovi le migliori pratiche, e garantirai che i componenti di architettura e i blocchi di costruzione siano riutilizzabili, scalabili e allineati a standard stabiliti. Attraverso la collaborazione in tutta l'organizzazione, si porterà gli sforzi per integrare applicazioni e sistemi in modo efficace, guidare l'innovazione e sostenere l'integrità architettonica dei prodotti di Roche. Inoltre, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel promuovere la strategia di piattaforma comune di Roche, contribuendo alla sua scalabilità, affidabilità, interoperabilità e allineamento con le esigenze di prodotti medici digitali e team di ingegneria. I vostri compiti e responsabilità
• Architectural Guardianship: Definire e mantenere la roadmap di Architettura e Architettura di riferimento, assicurando che tutte le soluzioni siano scalabili, affidabili e allineate alla strategia Roche Ecosystem.
• Strategia & Integrazione: Guidare la fornitura di strategie e progetti tecnologici attuabili, guidando l'integrazione delle applicazioni utilizzando blocchi di costruzione standard e componenti riutilizzabili.
• Leadership della piattaforma: Drive "platform-first" si avvicina, identificando le lacune tecniche e sviluppando soluzioni innovative per l'interoperabilità dei dati e le strutture basate sugli eventi.
• Collaborazione Stakeholder: Partner con ingegneri, Product Manager e team Sales/Medical per supportare i risultati strategici e garantire l'implementazione tecnologica coerente tra i prodotti di customer-facing.
• Quality & Risk Management: Analizzare i requisiti non funzionali (sicurezza, prestazioni, scalabilità) e stabilire la governance per ridurre la duplicazione e migliorare la robustezza del sistema. Chi sei
• Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea o Master in Informatica o Ingegneria, con almeno 10 anni di esperienza in business/reference architettura e strategie di piattaforma condivise.
• Esperienza tecnica: profonda conoscenza delle strategie di piattaforma, governance architettonica, API e modelli di servizi condivisi. Esperienza con piattaforme cloud (AWS, Azure, o GCP) e framework come TOGAF o SAFe è altamente apprezzata.
• Conoscenza del settore: familiarità con gli standard sanitari come FHIR e HL7 , insieme alle competenze nella progettazione e regolamentazioni del settore conformi.
• Soft Skills: competenze di consulenza e comunicazione avanzate, con una comprovata capacità di collaborare in ambienti interfunzionali e globali e tradurre obiettivi aziendali in roadmap tecniche. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.
Your tasks and Responsibilities

• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.

• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness.

Who you are

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Éducation et expérience: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique ou en génie, avec au moins 10 ans d'expérience en architecture d'affaires/de référence et stratégies de plateforme partagées.

• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。 ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応 ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明 ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成 ・保守契約の締結、請求

応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識
• ・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可

（歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方 ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション
• ・調整を取ってきた方 ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識 ・病院でのMEとしての経験

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

• 業務内容 （雇い入れ直後）：募集職種 フィールドサービスエンジニア
• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
• ※本社での6か月間の研修後、仙台オフィスへ配属予定。
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
• 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
• 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～ ※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
• 時間外固定手当：月51,936円 （時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
• ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など ※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休 暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

• 福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社 (Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。 ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応 ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明 ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成 ・保守契約の締結、請求

応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識
• ・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可

（歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方 ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション
• ・調整を取ってきた方 ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識 ・病院でのMEとしての経験

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

• 業務内容 （雇い入れ直後）：募集職種 フィールドサービスエンジニア
• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
• ※本社での6か月間の研修後、仙台オフィスへ配属予定。
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
• 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
• 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～ ※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
• 時間外固定手当：月51,936円 （時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
• ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など ※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休 暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

• 福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社 (Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Job Summary
한국로슈진단은 고객 중심의 영업 활동 을 통해 진단 분야의 혁신적인 가치를 전달하며, 시장 리더십을 강화할 영업 전문가를 찾고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고객 관리

• 기존 고객사를 관리하고 유지하며 매출 증대

• 신규 고객사 발굴 및 개발

2. 대리점 관리

• 대리점과 협력하여 매출 목표 달성

• 대리점 재고 모니터링 및 관리

• 제품 교육 실시

• 대리점 영업 활동 지원

3. 마케팅 및 영업 활동

• 월별/분기별 및 연간 매출 목표 달성

• 신규 장비 설치

• 기존 장비에 신규 제품 추가

4. 기술 지원

• 장비 및 시약 관련 고객 문의 및 요청사항 응대

La posizione
L'obiettivo primario di uno Specialista di Promozione Clinica è quello di aumentare l'utilizzo di tutti i prodotti e test all'interno della loro area di responsabilità visitando professionisti sanitari nella regione per scopi promozionali.

Tra i compiti principali e le responsabilità figurano:

• Promozione prodotto: Condurre promozioni di prodotti per medici e distributori all'interno del target di riferimento.

• Gestione dei feedback: Valutazione dei feedback ricevuti per quanto riguarda i prodotti e comunicare con i dipartimenti rilevanti all'interno della società per fornire risposte.

• Pianificazione: Preparazione ed esecuzione di piani di visita giornalieri, settimanali e mensili basati su frequenze di visita definite per il pubblico di destinazione.

• Consegna dei contenuti: Conveying contenuto approvato ai medici per garantire un aumento del consumo di prodotto.

• Controllo delle scorte: Esecuzione del controllo delle scorte dei prodotti ai distributori e monitoraggio della circolazione.

• Eventi: Partecipazione a congressi e simposio.

• Analisi: Condurre il settore e l'analisi dei concorrenti per monitorare gli sviluppi, raccogliere informazioni di mercato, interpretarlo e segnalare regolarmente

Chi sei?

• Laurea in medicina, biologia, chimica preferibilmente

• 1-2 anni di esperienza del rappresentante medico

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e presentazione

• Almeno livello intermedio di lingua inglese, fluente kazako e russa.

• Volontà a frequenti viaggi

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The primary objective of a Clinician Promotion Specialist is to increase the usage of all products and tests within their responsibility area by visiting health professionals in the region for promotional purposes.

Key duties and responsibilities include:

• Product Promotion: Conducting product promotions for clinicians and distributors within the target audience.

• Feedback Management: Evaluating feedback received regarding products and communicating with relevant departments within the company to provide responses.

• Planning: Preparing and executing daily, weekly, and monthly visit plans based on defined visit frequencies for the target audience.

• Content Delivery: Conveying approved content to clinicians to ensure an increase in product consumption.

• Stock Control: Performing stock control of products at distributors and monitoring circulation.

• Events: Participating in congresses and symposiums.

• Analysis: Conducting sector and competitor analysis to monitor developments, gather market information, interpret it, and report regularly

Who are you?

• Bachelor's Degree in medicine, biology, chemistry preferably

• 1-2 years’ experience of medical representative

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• At least intermediate level of English, fluent Kazakh and Russian language.

• Willing to frequent travel

Die Position
Das Hauptziel eines Clinician Promotion Specialist ist es, die Nutzung aller Produkte und Tests in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich zu erhöhen, indem sie Gesundheitsexperten in der Region zu Werbezwecken besuchen.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten gehören:

• Produktförderung: Durchführung von Produktaktionen für Kliniker und Händler innerhalb der Zielgruppe.

• Feedback Management: Bewertung des erhaltenen Feedbacks zu Produkten und Kommunikation mit relevanten Abteilungen innerhalb des Unternehmens, um Antworten zu geben.

• Planung: Vorbereitung und Ausführung von täglichen, wöchentlichen und monatlichen Besuchsplänen basierend auf definierten Besuchsfrequenzen für die Zielgruppe.

• Bereitstellung von Inhalten: Übermittlung von genehmigten Inhalten an Kliniker, um einen Anstieg des Produktverbrauchs zu gewährleisten.

• Bestandskontrolle: Durchführung einer Bestandskontrolle von Produkten bei Händlern und Überwachung des Umlaufs.

• Veranstaltungen: Teilnahme an Kongressen und Symposien.

• Analyse: Durchführung von Branchen- und Wettbewerberanalysen, um Entwicklungen zu überwachen, Marktinformationen zu sammeln, sie zu interpretieren und regelmäßig zu berichten

Wer bist du?

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Medizin, Biologie, Chemie vorzugsweise

• 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung als medizinischer Vertreter

• Starke Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten

• Mindestens mittleres Niveau der englischen, fließend kasachischen und russischen Sprache.

Join us on this exciting journey and combine your technical skills with a deeper meaning.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a dedicated and experienced pharmaceutical expert (m/f/d) at our site in Mannheim, who will support us in the department Near Patient Care - Intermediates full-time. If you feel like working in a dynamic and respectful environment and feel addressed in the profile below, don’t hesitate and apply!

• Execution of manual assembly and manufacturing activities

• Optical control of the manufactured products

• Manufacture/machine operation:

• Cross-division operation of various manufacturing facilities for the production or packaging of medical devices

• Setting up of manufacturing equipment Material provision and documentation

• Performing batch changes and their documentation

• Controlling the manufacturing process and documentation in the event of deviations

• Performance of product and process testing

• Performing the pattern drawing according to currently valid specifications

• Material preparation of directly and indirectly required materials

• Organisation of production facility workflows

• Operational receipt of (chemical) raw materials and entry into production systems

• Implementation of physical and digital raw material management

• Production of partial bottling (liquotation) of raw materials

• Implementation of the work on the basis of fully digital specification and proof documents

• Supply and disposal of production plants by material request, transport, appropriate labelling and disposal of materials

• Provision of pallets for in-house transport and storage in high-bay warehouses

• Acceptance and transfer of small quantities of (chemical) raw materials and their digital management

• Production facilities activities:

• Performing simple technical maintenance activities or correcting simple technical failures as specified

• Conversions of format parts and removable assemblies as specified

• Cleaning the workplace and manufacturing equipment

• Organisational activities:

• Support

The Position

Missions:
As part of the application of French regulations, Group directives and standards, the SHE specialist defines and guarantees the proper functioning and monitoring of procedures related to Health, Safety, Hygiene and the Environment (SHE) in order to prevent and reduce SHE risks within the company.
Furthermore, the SHE specialist brings the Roche Group's SHE policy to life within the subsidiary.

Main Responsibilities:

DU and Prevention of Physical and Psychosocial Risks at work

• Generally speaking, the SHE specialist is responsible for defining and implementing the professional risk management and prevention policy within the company and with respect to our customers, in compliance with applicable standards and procedures and the dissemination of a culture of prevention in the company. The SHE specialist also manages the OHS organization and guides and stringent lines (training, zoning, etc.)

• He is also responsible for the analysis and prevention of risks inherent to workstations, whether at headquarters, roaming or with our Customers, in connection with our DUERP, in order to carry out targeted actions (e.g. road risk, gesture and posture, PPE, ergonomics, etc.)

• He participates in the detection, management and monitoring of potential cases of RPS in conjunction with stakeholders such as HR, elected officials and the health center

• He has shared responsibility for monitoring accidentology and associated administrative management (accident investigation, declaration, record keeping, reporting, etc.) and for identifying, if necessary, immediate corrective actions in order to limit the risk - particularly in relation to group initiatives.

• He organizes periodic visits to the facilities with stakeholders to ensure proper compliance and application of site security measures.

Onboarding of new employees and regulatory monitoring

• Organization of SHE training: identification of needs, planning, monitoring of the welcoming process for new hires, but also monitoring and organization of refresher training (electrical clearances, SST, etc.)

• Is responsible for ensuring that the company is always up to date with regulatory developments in the areas of personal safety and the environment, in its practices and procedures as well as in updating the Group's platform.

Waste management

• Improvement of our processes and solutions to reduce the production of our waste on site and monitoring of waste at our service providers (notably WEEE)

Reporting

• Defines and carries out on time the reporting associated with its activity

• (SHE reporting, and contribution to the CSR report, BDES etc...)

Internal and External CSR

• Participates in the CSR steering committee and in the preparation of the annual report

• Communication actions across all activities

• Customer part (prevention plan)

• Prepares CSSCT subjects related to their expertise

SHE and SQB audit

• Implementation of audits with critical suppliers (as part of a qualification or monitoring: documentary or physical audit)

• Participates in the Supplier Quality Board (SQB)

Biosafety Officer

• Assessment and management of biological and chemical risks

• Compliance and regulations: ensure strict compliance with local and international laws

• Raise awareness and train employees in good practices

• Supervise decontamination and sanitation protocols

Im Rahmen der Anwendung französischer Vorschriften, Konzernrichtlinien und Standards definiert und garantiert der SGU-Spezialist das ordnungsgemäße Funktionieren und die Überwachung von Verfahren im Zusammenhang mit Gesundheit, Sicherheit, Hygiene und Umwelt (SHE), um SGU-Risiken im Unternehmen vorzubeugen und zu reduzieren.

DU und Prävention physischer und psychosozialer Risiken am Arbeitsplatz

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Quali saranno le vostre principali responsabilità?
Fornirai un supporto diretto al team People Relations nella gestione quotidiana del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti e delle relazioni di lavoro collettive, collaborando nelle seguenti aree:

• Consulenza interna: Sostenere la risoluzione dei quesiti dei dipendenti relativi all'accordo di contrattazione collettiva, ai diritti di lavoro, alle politiche di congedo, ai diritti di vacanza e alla legislazione spagnola sul lavoro.

• Relazioni con i dipendenti e i lavoratori: assistenza nella preparazione di documenti e relazioni per i rappresentanti dei lavoratori (Consiglio dei lavoratori), ispezioni del lavoro e processi di contrattazione collettiva. Preparare i verbali delle riunioni e le presentazioni relative ai temi dell'occupazione e delle relazioni di lavoro.

• Gestione dei casi e conformità: Sostenere l'amministrazione e il follow-up dei processi disciplinari, iniziative di ristrutturazione organizzativa, procedure di conciliazione amministrativa e questioni di lavoro, garantendo al contempo il rispetto della legislazione spagnola del lavoro e delle politiche interne.

• Rapporti e progetti internazionali: preparare rapporti di lavoro e documentazione in inglese, contribuire al monitoraggio delle metriche chiave e sostenere il team globale di People & Culture.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Istruzione: attualmente si sta perseguendo una laurea in Relazioni col lavoro e risorse umane, diritto, o una laurea magistrale / post-laurea specializzata in diritto del lavoro o diritto del lavoro in Spagna.

• Lingue: Inglese fluente (livello minimo B2/C1), sia scritto che parlato, con la capacità di collaborare con team internazionali e interpretare la documentazione aziendale.

• Ammissibilità: È necessario essere idonei a firmare un accordo di stage (Convenio de Prácticas) con un istituto universitario o educativo in Spagna.

• Competenze chiave: forte attenzione ai dettagli, mentalità analitica, capacità di gestire le informazioni riservate con discrezione, eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e un atteggiamento proattivo.

• Competenze tecniche: competenza in Microsoft Office (in particolare Excel e PowerPoint). La conoscenza dei sistemi HR come Workday sarà considerata un vantaggio.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What will your main responsibilities be?
You will provide direct support to the People Relations team in the day-to-day management of the employee lifecycle and collective labour relations, collaborating in the following areas:

• Internal advisory: Support the resolution of employee queries related to the collective bargaining agreement, employment rights, leave policies, vacation entitlements, and Spanish labour legislation.

• Employee and labour relations: Assist in the preparation of documentation and reports for Employee Representatives (Works Council), labour inspections, and collective bargaining processes. Prepare meeting minutes and presentations related to employment and labour relations topics.

• Case management and compliance: Support the administration and follow-up of disciplinary processes, organisational restructuring initiatives, administrative conciliation procedures, and employment litigation matters, while ensuring compliance with Spanish labour legislation and internal policies.

• Reporting and international projects: Prepare labour relations reports and documentation in English, contributing to the monitoring of key metrics and supporting the global People & Culture team.

What are we looking for?

• Education: You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Labour Relations and Human Resources, Law, or a Master's/Postgraduate qualification specialising in Labour Law or Employment Law in Spain.

• Languages: Fluent English (minimum B2/C1 level), both written and spoken, with the ability to collaborate with international teams and interpret corporate documentation.

• Eligibility: You must be eligible to sign an internship agreement ( Convenio de Prácticas ) with a university or educational institution in Spain.

• Key competencies: Strong attention to detail, analytical mindset, ability to handle confidential information with discretion, excellent communication skills, and a proactive attitude.

• Technical skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (particularly Excel and PowerPoint). Knowledge of HR systems such as Workday will be considered an advantage.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Was werden Ihre Hauptaufgaben sein?
Sie unterstützen das Team von People Relations direkt bei der täglichen Verwaltung des Mitarbeiterlebenszyklus und der kollektiven Arbeitsbeziehungen und arbeiten in folgenden Bereichen zusammen:

• Interne Beratung: Unterstützung bei der Lösung von Mitarbeiteranfragen im Zusammenhang mit dem Tarifvertrag, Arbeitsrechten, Urlaubsrichtlinien, Urlaubsansprüchen und dem spanischen Arbeitsrecht.

• Mitarbeiter- und Arbeitsbeziehungen: Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Dokumentationen und Berichten für Arbeitnehmervertreter (Betriebsrat), Arbeitsinspektionen und Tarifverhandlungen. Bereiten Sie Sitzungsprotokolle und Präsentationen zu Beschäftigungs- und Arbeitsbeziehungen vor.

• Fallmanagement und Compliance: Unterstützung der Verwaltung und Weiterverfolgung von Disziplinarverfahren, organisatorischen Restrukturierungsinitiativen, administrativen Schlichtungsverfahren und Fragen der Arbeitsrechtsstreitigkeiten bei gleichzeitiger Einhaltung der spanischen Arbeitsgesetzgebung und internen Richtlinien.

• Berichterstattung und internationale Projekte: Bereiten Sie Arbeitsbeziehungsberichte und -dokumentationen in englischer Sprache vor, tragen Sie zur Überwachung wichtiger Metriken bei und unterstützen Sie das globale People & Culture-Team.

Worauf warten wir?

• Ausbildung: Sie verfolgen derzeit einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Arbeitsbeziehungen und Personalwesen, Recht oder eine Master- / Postgraduiertenqualifikation, die auf Arbeitsrecht oder Arbeitsrecht in Spanien spezialisiert ist.

• Sprachen: fließendes Englisch (Mindestniveau B2/C1), sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen, mit der Fähigkeit, mit internationalen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und Unternehmensdokumentation zu interpretieren.

• Berechtigung: Sie müssen berechtigt sein, einen Praktikumsvertrag ( Convenio de Prácticas) mit einer Universität oder Bildungseinrichtung in Spanien zu unterzeichnen.

• Schlüsselkompetenzen: Starke Liebe zum Detail, analytische Denkweise, Fähigkeit, vertrauliche Informationen diskret zu behandeln, ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine proaktive Einstellung.

• Technische Fähigkeiten: Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office (insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint). Die Kenntnis von HR-Systemen wie Workday wird als Vorteil angesehen.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Quelles seront vos principales responsabilités?
Vous fournirez un soutien direct à l'équipe des relations humaines dans la gestion quotidienne du cycle de vie des employés et des relations de travail collectives, en collaborant dans les domaines suivants :

• Conseil interne : Appuyer le règlement des questions des employés concernant la convention collective, les droits à l'emploi, les politiques de congé, les congés annuels et la législation du travail espagnole.

• Relations de travail et relations de travail : Aider à la préparation de documents et de rapports destinés aux représentants des employés (Conseil du travail), aux inspections du travail et aux processus de négociation collective. Préparer des procès-verbaux et des présentations sur des sujets liés à l'emploi et aux relations de travail.

• Gestion des cas et conformité: soutenir l'administration et le suivi des procédures disciplinaires, des initiatives de restructuration organisationnelle, des procédures de conciliation administrative et des litiges en matière d'emploi, tout en veillant au respect de la législation du travail et des politiques internes espagnoles.

• Rapports et projets internationaux : Préparer des rapports et de la documentation sur les relations de travail en anglais, contribuer au suivi des mesures clés et soutenir l'équipe mondiale People & Culture.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?

• Éducation: Vous êtes actuellement titulaire d'un baccalauréat en relations de travail et ressources humaines, droit, ou d'une maîtrise / diplôme spécialisé en droit du travail ou droit de l'emploi en Espagne.

• Langues : Anglais fluide (niveau minimum B2/C1), à la fois écrit et parlé, avec la capacité de collaborer avec des équipes internationales et d'interpréter la documentation de l'entreprise.

• Admissibilité : Vous devez être admissible à un contrat de stage ( Convenio de Prácticas ) avec une université ou un établissement d'enseignement en Espagne.

• Compétences clés : Une grande attention aux détails, à l'état d'esprit analytique, à la capacité de traiter l'information confidentielle avec discrétion, à d'excellentes compétences en communication et à une attitude proactive.

• Compétences techniques: Compétence dans Microsoft Office (en particulier Excel et PowerPoint). La connaissance de systèmes de RH comme Workday sera considérée comme un avantage.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Wir arbeiten virtuell und real Hand in Hand.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In der Rolle übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die Gewährleistung der Arbeitssicherheit am Standort durch die Beratung zu, Implementierung und Überprüfung von zukunftsorientierten Sicherheitskonzepten in Neu- und Umbauprojekten (Capex) ab der frühen Planung bis zur Ausführung auf der Baustelle. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Gesetzlicher Arbeitsschutz: Du nimmst die Aufgaben einer bestellten Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (SiFa) im Projekt vollumfänglich wahr und stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Regelwerke (z. B. BetrSichV, GefStoffV) sicher.

• Dokumentenmanagement & Koordination: Du verantwortest die Erstellung, Prüfung, Moderation und rechtssichere Archivierung (SAP / DVS) von SHE-Konzepten, Baustellensicherheitskonzepten, Checklisten und Reviews.

• Wissenschaftliche Bewertungen: Du verantwortest fundierte Ermittlungen sowie biologische, thermische oder toxikologische Bewertungen am Arbeitsplatz als Basis für lückenlose Gefährdungsbeurteilungen im Projektumfeld.

• Kulturarbeit & Coaching: Du coachst sowie moderierst Programme zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer proaktiven Sicherheitskultur (Behavior Based Safety) und gibst dein Wissen in fachspezifischen Schulungen weiter.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium (Bachelor/Master) im Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Verfahrenstechnik, Chemie, Bauingenieurwesen, Sicherheitstechnik), einen Master in Naturwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen und besitzt die Ausbildung zur Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit gemäß § 7 AS

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Stellenübersicht
Der Facilities Engineer ist verantwortlich für die Durchführung von Engineering-Projekten und die Koordinierung der technischen
Wartungstätigkeiten und Gewährleistung des zuverlässigen Betriebs von Gebäudesystemen und kritischen
Versorgungsunternehmen am Standort Roche Sant Cugat.
Berichterstattung an die Lead HARD Services, die Rolle fungiert als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Roche
und externe Dienstleister, Gewährleistung von Instandhaltungstätigkeiten, Engineering-Projekte,
Compliance-Anforderungen und technische Dokumentation werden sicher, effizient und in
nach Roche-Standards.
Die Position verbindet technische Expertise mit starker Projektkoordination und Stakeholder
Management, das sich auf die Ausführung und nicht auf strategisches Eigentum konzentriert.

Schlüssel
• Zuständigkeiten
● Verwalten und liefern Engineering- und Automatisierungsprojekte von Anfang bis Ende, verwalten
kleine und mittlere Ingenieur- und Infrastrukturprojekte und unterstützen größere
CAPEX-Initiativen unter der Leitung von Lead HARD Services. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Definition
Projektumfang, Verfolgung von Zeitplänen, Management von Risiken und Gewährleistung einer strukturierten Übergabe an
Operationen. Erstellen und pflegen Sie kritische Projektdokumentation.
● Koordinieren Sie die täglichen Aktivitäten von technischen Auftragnehmern, überwachen Sie die Serviceleistung
gegen etablierte KPIs und stellen eine genaue Berichterstattung durch Roche-Wartung sicher
Systeme. Sie integrieren Auftragnehmer in die Tools und Dashboards von Roche und stellen sicher, dass
Sie berichten über standardisierte, qualitativ hochwertige Wartungsmetriken, um zuverlässig zu garantieren
Betriebsdaten.
● Prüfungsbereitschaft und Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften sicherstellen: Support und Koordination technischer
Audits und amtliche Inspektionen (einschließlich APQ, Niederspannung und Brandschutz / PCI).
Bewahren Sie alle Wartungsaufzeichnungen, Zertifizierungen und technischen Dokumentationen vollständig auf
organisiert, aktualisiert und bereit für die Überprüfung und Nachverfolgung von Korrekturmaßnahmen, die sich aus
Audits und Inspektionen bis zum Abschluss.
● Nachhaltigkeit und digitale Transformation unterstützen: Beitrag zu Energieeinsparung und
CO2-Reduktionsinitiativen durch effizientes Asset Management, Maximierung der Nutzung von
digitale Werkzeuge, um datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung zu ermöglichen.
● Pflegen Sie die kollaborative und proaktive Kommunikation mit internen Stakeholdern: Build
starke, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zwischen den Abteilungen. Zeigen Sie aktive Bereitschaft, andere zu unterstützen
Bereiche, und proaktiv aktualisieren Teamleiter vor technischen Eingriffen oder Vorfällen
Auswirkungen auf ihren täglichen Betrieb.
● Überwachung des täglichen technischen Betriebs und der Wartung von Anlagen: Präventiv koordinieren,
von externen Dienstleistern durchgeführte vorausschauende und korrigierende Wartungstätigkeiten,
Gewährleistung der Verfügbarkeit von Anlagen, der technischen Qualität, der Sicherheit und der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften. für alle
Gebäudeversorgung (HVAC, Strom, Wasser und Gas) und kritische automatisierte Logistik
Anlagen, um eine maximale Betriebsverfügbarkeit und Sicherheit zu gewährleisten.
● Wahrung der Integrität der Anlagen- und Wartungsdaten innerhalb des CMMS, Gewährleistung der Arbeit
Aufträge, vorbeugende Wartungspläne, Ersatzteilinformationen und technische Unterlagen
Die Dokumentation bleibt korrekt und aktuell.
● Unterstützung von Ursachenuntersuchungen für technische Fehler, Vorschlagen und Implementieren
Korrektur- und Vorbeugungsmaßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit der Anlagen.

Wer du bist
● Konzentrieren Sie sich darauf, Probleme zu lösen, anstatt Schwierigkeiten zu erklären, und präsentieren Sie praktische Optionen
wenn technische Herausforderungen auftreten.
● Bauen Sie starke Beziehungen zwischen den Abteilungen auf und aktualisieren Sie interne Kunden proaktiv
bevor technische Probleme ihren Betrieb beeinflussen.
● Konzentrieren Sie sich darauf, Dinge zu verwirklichen, indem Sie externe Partner leiten und beaufsichtigen

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Aperçu de l'emploi
L'ingénieur des installations est responsable de la réalisation de projets d'ingénierie, de la coordination technique
des activités d'entretien, et assurer le fonctionnement fiable des systèmes de construction et des
services publics sur le site de Roche Sant Cugat.
Sous l'autorité des Services HARD, le rôle joue le rôle d'interface technique entre Roche
et fournisseurs de services externes, assurant des activités de maintenance, des projets d'ingénierie,
les exigences de conformité et la documentation technique sont exécutées de façon sûre, efficace et
Conformément aux normes Roche.
Le poste combine l'expertise technique avec une forte coordination du projet et les parties prenantes
la gestion, en mettant l'accent sur l'exécution plutôt que sur l'appropriation stratégique.

Clé
• Responsabilités
● Gérer et livrer des projets d'ingénierie et d'automatisation du début à la fin, gérer
projets d ' ingénierie et d ' infrastructure de petite et moyenne taille et appui à des projets plus importants
Les initiatives du CAPEX menées par les services responsables de la défense. Vous serez chargé de définir
la portée du projet, le suivi des échéanciers, la gestion des risques et la
les opérations. Préparer et tenir à jour la documentation essentielle du projet.

● Maintenir une communication collaborative et proactive avec les intervenants internes :

et de mettre à jour de façon proactive les chefs d'équipe avant les interventions ou incidents techniques
impact sur leurs opérations quotidiennes.
