This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
• Performs advanced accounting functions requiring thorough knowledge of accounting methods, principles, and practices.
• Responsible for complex analysis and audits of accounting transactions, processes and interrelationships.
• Identifies complex accounting issues, and researches and recommends implementation plans for new and existing accounting policies and guidance.
• Examines and audits financial statements and documents for conformance with accounting requirements and principles.
• Key contact to affiliates for accounting and reporting topics.
• Serves as an internal resource by sharing best practice and expertise to colleagues .
• May have lead responsibilities for special projects, strategic implementations, etc.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
• Leads complex accounting analysis and auditing for assigned area of responsibility. Serves as the subject matter expert for affiliates served and an internal resource for colleagues. .
• Prepare a variety of complex financial and/or cost activities, statements and/or reports including but not limited to trial balances, balance sheets, financial statements, profit-and-loss statements or statements of sourcing and application of funds. Prepares journal entries for entry into the general ledger or cost accounting system on a monthly basis by collecting necessary data, analyzing and/or allocating costs, and preparing audit train support for the journal entries.
• Prepares appropriate commentary or explanations relating to report items of particular interest or significance. Conducts any investigations of the accounts involved. Recommends to management the actions to be taken.
• Supplies or explains data to customers, secures information, or describes data which could be made available. Provides advice on accounting matters especially when based on well-established principles and practices.
• Ensures that systems and procedures are in compliance with company policies, acceptable accounting practices, and applicable regulations.
• Serves as an internal resource to colleagues and assists in their development and training. May review the work of peers. Performs other duties and assist or lead with projects as needed

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance
• Proven knowledge of finance and accounting principals and practices GAAP or IFRS and auditing
• Knowledge of applications in a computerized environment, including spreadsheets applications, and data bases (e.g. Excel, PowerPoint, Word, G-Suite, etc.)
• Proven analytical, and accuracy skills. Requires attention to details
• Effective written and verbal communication skills .
• Strong ability to prioritize and organize work effectively, adhere to tight and established deadlines
• Knowledge of Finance Shared Services and operational accounting processes and related technology systems ( e.g . SAP, Blackline, Service Now, Consolidation Systems etc.)
• Experience working with one or more SAP Modules (i.e. FCC, FI, CO/PA, MM, and FA).

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Esperto delle operazioni di apprendimento del consulente tecnologico

Introduzione Come consulente tecnologico a livello SE6 all'interno di RDT Performance & Insights, si assume un ruolo di leadership di matrice per fornire una diversità di prodotti ad alto impatto e progetti multi-facciati. Condurrai squadre o squadre interne ed esterne in un'organizzazione di matrice, sviluppando approcci avanzati come la gestione del backlog Agile, e guidando la linea temporale e la strategia tra i team di prodotto. Applicando la vostra profonda esperienza nella consulenza e nella conoscenza del dominio del processo aziendale competente, risolverete problemi insolitamente complessi con soluzioni altamente innovative, gestire relazioni di stakeholder di alto livello in tutta l'azienda, e attivamente i colleghi di mentore per promuovere un ambiente collaborativo e ad alto rendimento.
L'opportunità:

• Lead Matrix Squads & Deliveries: Lead team interni, esterni e non ufficiali tra le organizzazioni di matrice per offrire con successo una vasta gamma di prodotti ad alto impatto e progetti di attività di apprendimento.

• Architetto Agile Timelines: Sviluppare e implementare approcci operativi avanzati, come la gestione del backlog Agile, definendo tempi di consegna chiari e priorità tra team e team di prodotto.

• Gestisci i Backlog Enterprise: Prioritizzare, pianificare e segnalare lo stato di esecuzione a livello multi-prodotto, enterprise o product-line per garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali .

• Risolvere le sfide tecniche complesse: condurre l'analisi delle cause root e risolvere i problemi per problemi insolitamente complessi, proponendo soluzioni altamente innovative e miglioramenti dei processi .

• Strategie di linea del prodotto: strategie di forma del prodotto e della linea di prodotto applicando tendenze del settore approfondite, analisi avanzata dei dati e principi tecnici per la creazione del valore massimo.

• Gestisci gli stakeholder aziendali: Costruire e mantenere relazioni di alto livello con i principali stakeholder aziendali, garantendo risultati di progetto allineati alle aspettative strategiche in più portafogli .

• Tailor Strategic Communications: Comunicare informazioni tecniche complesse, rischi e soluzioni proposte in modo efficace in tutta l'azienda, adattando messaggistica e canali per il pubblico vario.

• Foster Collaborative Environments: Lead cross-product collaborative team ambienti e iniziative di sviluppo organizzativo campione, come ad esempio la dimostrazione di leadership attiva in Community of Practice (CoPs) .

Chi sei:

• Professionista Educato: Hai una laurea o Master in Informatica, Informatica, Business Administration, o un campo relativo .

• Consulente tecnologico esperto: si portano 5+ anni di esperienza di consulenza, tra cui 3+ anni di esperienza specializzata in scienze della vita / farmaci o la funzione aziendale assegnata essere supportato.

• Consulenza Dominio Esperto: Possiedi conoscenze avanzate di concetti e pratiche di consulenza, con profonda competenza in almeno una primaria capacità di consulenza e di business processo di conoscenza del dominio .

• Technical & Process Analyst: Lei dimostra forti capacità nell'applicazione di principi tecnici avanzati, teorie e concetti relativi a requisiti, dati, usabilità e analisi di processo.

• Complex Problem Solver: Hai una comprovata traccia di lavoro su progetti multi-facciati e risolvere con successo problemi insolitamente complessi con soluzioni tecniche innovative.

• Enterprise Stakeholder Manager: Porti eccezionali capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di navigare in portafogli di livello enterprise
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technology Consultant Learning Operations Expert

Introduction As a Technology Consultant at the SE6 level within RDT Performance & Insights, you will take on a matrix leadership role to deliver on a diversity of high-impact products and multi-faceted projects . You will lead both internal and external teams or squads in a matrix organization, developing advanced approaches like Agile backlog management, and driving the timeline and strategy across product teams . By applying your deep expertise in consultancy and proficient business process domain knowledge, you will solve unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions, manage high-level stakeholder relationships across the enterprise, and actively mentor colleagues to foster a collaborative and high-performing environment .
The Opportunity:

• Lead Matrix Squads & Deliveries: Lead internal, external, and unofficial teams across matrix organizations to successfully deliver on a wide diversity of high-impact products and learning operations projects .

• Architect Agile Timelines: Develop and implement advanced operational approaches—such as Agile backlog management—defining clear delivery timelines and priorities across product teams and squads .

• Manage Enterprise Backlogs: Prioritize, plan, and report execution status at the multi-product, enterprise, or product-line level to ensure alignment with business objectives .

• Solve Complex Technical Challenges: Conduct root-cause analysis and problem-solving for unusually complex issues, proposing highly innovative solutions and process improvements .

• Influence Product Line Strategies: Shape product and product-line strategies by applying in-depth industry trends, advanced data analysis, and technical principles for maximum value creation .

• Manage Enterprise Stakeholders: Build and maintain high-level relationships with key enterprise stakeholders, ensuring project outcomes align with strategic expectations across multiple portfolios .

• Tailor Strategic Communications: Communicate complex technical information, risks, and proposed solutions effectively across the enterprise, adapting messaging and channels for diverse audiences .

• Foster Collaborative Environments: Lead cross-product collaborative team environments and champion organizational development initiatives, such as showing active leadership in Communities of Practice (CoPs) .

Who you are:

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field .

• Experienced Technology Consultant: You bring 5+ years of consultancy experience, including 3+ years of specialized experience in life sciences/pharma or the assigned business function being supported .

• Consultancy Domain Expert: You possess advanced knowledge of consultancy concepts and practices, with deep expertise in at least one primary consultancy capability and business process domain knowledge .

• Technical & Process Analyst: You demonstrate strong capabilities in applying advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis .

• Complex Problem Solver: You have a proven track record of working on multi-faceted projects and successfully resolving unusually complex problems with innovative technical solutions .

• Enterprise Stakeholder Manager: You bring exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate enterprise-level portfolios

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Technologieberater Learning Operations Experte

Einleitung Als Technologieberater auf SE6-Ebene bei RDT Performance & Insights übernehmen Sie eine führende Rolle in der Matrix, um eine Vielzahl von leistungsstarken Produkten und facettenreichen Projekten zu liefern. Sie führen sowohl interne als auch externe Teams oder Squads in einer Matrixorganisation, entwickeln fortschrittliche Ansätze wie Agile Backlog Management und steuern die Zeitleiste und Strategie in allen Produktteams. Durch die Anwendung Ihrer fundierten Expertise in der Beratung und kompetenten Geschäftsprozess-Domänenkenntnissen lösen Sie ungewöhnlich komplexe Probleme mit hochinnovativen Lösungen, verwalten hochrangige Stakeholder-Beziehungen im gesamten Unternehmen und beraten aktiv Kollegen, um eine kollaborative und leistungsstarke Umgebung zu fördern.
Die Gelegenheit:

• Leiten Sie Matrix Squads & Deliveries: Führen Sie interne, externe und inoffizielle Teams in Matrixorganisationen, um eine Vielzahl von leistungsstarken Produkten und Lernprojekten erfolgreich durchzuführen.

• Architect Agile Timelines: Entwickeln und implementieren Sie fortschrittliche operative Ansätze wie Agile Backlog Management, um klare Lieferzeiten und Prioritäten für Produktteams und -teams festzulegen.

• Manage Enterprise Backlogs: Priorisieren, planen und melden Sie den Ausführungsstatus auf Multi-Produkt-, Unternehmens- oder Produktlinienebene, um die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele sicherzustellen.

• Lösen Sie komplexe technische Herausforderungen: Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse und Problemlösung für ungewöhnlich komplexe Probleme durch und schlagen Sie hochinnovative Lösungen und Prozessverbesserungen vor.

• Beeinflussen Sie Produktlinienstrategien: Gestalten Sie Produkt- und Produktlinienstrategien, indem Sie tiefgreifende Branchentrends, fortschrittliche Datenanalysen und technische Prinzipien für maximale Wertschöpfung anwenden.

• Manage Enterprise Stakeholders: Aufbau und Pflege von hochrangigen Beziehungen zu wichtigen Unternehmensakteuren, um sicherzustellen, dass die Projektergebnisse mit den strategischen Erwartungen in mehreren Portfolios übereinstimmen.

• Maßgeschneiderte strategische Kommunikation: Kommunizieren Sie komplexe technische Informationen, Risiken und Lösungsvorschläge effektiv im gesamten Unternehmen und passen Sie Messaging und Kanäle für verschiedene Zielgruppen an.

• Fördern Sie kollaborative Umgebungen: Führen Sie produktübergreifende kollaborative Teamumgebungen und setzen Sie sich für Organisationsentwicklungsinitiativen ein, z. B. aktive Führung in Communities of Practice (CoPs).

Wer du bist:

• Educated Professional: Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Erfahrener Technologieberater: Sie bringen 5+ Jahre Beratungserfahrung mit, darunter 3+ Jahre Spezialerfahrung in Life Sciences / Pharma oder die zugewiesene Geschäftsfunktion, die unterstützt wird.

• Consultancy Domain Expert: Sie verfügen über fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Beratungskonzepten und -praktiken, mit fundiertem Fachwissen in mindestens einer primären Beratungskompetenz und Geschäftsprozess-Domänenwissen.

• Technical & Process Analyst: Sie zeigen starke Fähigkeiten bei der Anwendung fortschrittlicher technischer Prinzipien, Theorien und Konzepte in Bezug auf Anforderungen, Daten, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Prozessanalyse.

• Komplexer Problemlöser: Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Arbeit an facettenreichen Projekten und der erfolgreichen Lösung ungewöhnlich komplexer Probleme mit innovativen technischen Lösungen.

• Enterprise Stakeholder Manager: Sie bringen außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management mit der Fähigkeit, Portfolios auf Unternehmensebene zu navigieren
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Consultant en technologie Expert en opérations d'apprentissage

Présentation En tant que consultant en technologie au niveau SE6 au sein de RDT Performance & Insights, vous assumerez un rôle de leadership matriciel pour réaliser une diversité de produits à fort impact et de projets à multiples facettes. Vous dirigerez des équipes ou des équipes internes et externes dans une organisation matricielle, développerez des approches avancées comme la gestion de l'arriéré Agile, et piloterez le calendrier et la stratégie entre les équipes de produits. En appliquant votre expertise approfondie en matière de conseil et de connaissances spécialisées en matière de processus d'affaires, vous résoudrez des problèmes inhabituellement complexes avec des solutions hautement innovantes, gérerez des relations de haut niveau avec les intervenants dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, et mentorez activement vos collègues pour favoriser un environnement collaboratif et performant.
La possibilité :

• Equipes et livraisons de matrices principales : Diriger des équipes internes, externes et non officielles dans toutes les organisations matricielles afin d'offrir avec succès une grande diversité de produits à fort impact et de projets d'activités d'apprentissage.

• Architecte Agile Échéanciers : Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des approches opérationnelles avancées – comme la gestion de l'arriéré Agile – définissant clairement les délais et les priorités d'exécution pour les équipes et les équipes de produits.

• Gérer les Backlogs d'entreprise: Prioriser, planifier et rapporter l'état d'exécution au niveau multi-produits, d'entreprise ou de gamme de produits pour assurer l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels.

• Résoudre les défis techniques complexes : Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et résoudre les problèmes pour des questions inhabituellement complexes, en proposant des solutions hautement innovantes et des améliorations de processus.

• Influence Stratégies de gamme de produits : Former les stratégies de gamme de produits et de gamme de produits en appliquant des tendances industrielles approfondies, des analyses de données avancées et des principes techniques pour la création de valeur maximale.

• Gérer les intervenants de l'entreprise : Établir et maintenir des relations de haut niveau avec les principaux intervenants de l'entreprise, en veillant à ce que les résultats des projets correspondent aux attentes stratégiques de plusieurs portefeuilles.

• Adapter les communications stratégiques : Communiquer efficacement les informations techniques complexes, les risques et les solutions proposées dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, en adaptant les messages et les canaux à divers publics.

• Favoriser les environnements de collaboration : Diriger les environnements d'équipes de collaboration interproduits et promouvoir les initiatives de développement organisationnel, comme la démonstration d'un leadership actif dans les communautés de pratique.

Qui vous êtes :

• Professionnel formé: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en technologie de l'information, informatique, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

• Consultant en technologie expérimenté: Vous apportez 5 ans et plus d'expérience en conseil, y compris 3 ans et plus d'expérience spécialisée en sciences de la vie/pharmacie ou la fonction commerciale assignée étant soutenue.

• Expert du domaine de conseil : Vous possédez des connaissances avancées en matière de concepts et de pratiques de conseil, avec une expertise approfondie dans au moins une capacité de conseil primaire et des connaissances de domaine de processus d'affaires .

• Technical & Process Analyste: Vous démontrez de solides capacités dans l'application de principes techniques avancés, théories et concepts liés aux exigences, données, facilité d'utilisation et analyse de processus.

• Résolveur de problèmes complexes: Vous avez une expérience éprouvée de travail sur des projets à facettes multiples et résoudre avec succès des problèmes inhabituellement complexes avec des solutions techniques innovantes.

• Gestionnaire des intervenants d'entreprise: Vous apportez des compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité de naviguer au niveau des portefeuilles d'entreprise

Facendo da consulente di fiducia, sarete campione di responsabilità, membri del team mentore junior, e migliorare il processo di guida che allineano le soluzioni consegnate con obiettivi aziendali overarching .

Principali responsabilità

• Collabora con team interfunzionali, tra cui Product Manager, Architetti, Ingegneri e Designer UX, per definire ambiti, soluzioni, vincoli e rischi di progetto.

• Gestisci processi e sistemi di documentazione di conformità, caratterizzando le soluzioni aziendali per il rispetto delle normative interne ed esterne.

• Essere responsabili per la creazione e la manutenzione di:

• Valutazione del rischio di sistema e rapporti sulla classificazione dei dati.

• Requisiti dell'utente e specifiche funzionali/tecniche.

• Piani di convalida, report e registri.

• Requisiti Traceability Matrices, piani di prova e rapporti di prova.

• Dati/Process diagrammi di flusso e documentazione di formazione.

• Configurare le impostazioni del sistema e fornire consulenza ai clienti per quanto riguarda i miglioramenti delle soluzioni e le nuove implementazioni.

• Servire come partner affidabile per i team Global Privacy, IT Security e Business Quality, mantenendo la conoscenza a livello di esperti degli standard di governance (ad esempio, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485).

• Guidare la risoluzione di problemi di business o sistemi in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto.

• Migliorare la creazione e la manutenzione della documentazione di conformità (ad esempio, valutazioni dei rischi di sistema, piani di convalida, requisiti Matrici di tracebilità) sfruttando l'automazione guidata da AI per ridurre lo sforzo manuale mantenendo il rigore di conformità.

• Attuazione di strumenti di controllo della qualità assistiti da AI per automatizzare la convalida dei dati, il rilevamento di anomalia e i controlli di consistenza cross-platform, garantendo l'integrità dei dati e l'adesione agli standard GxP/CSV in scala.

• Utilizzare strumenti analitici alimentati da AI per monitorare le prestazioni della piattaforma, identificare proattivamente i colli di processo e generare metriche di conformità di audit-ready.

• Guidare l'implementazione strategica degli agenti AI all'interno del paesaggio IT Quality, assicurando che i flussi di lavoro assistiti dall'IA rimangano conformi al design e supportano efficacemente i requisiti aziendali.

Profilo dell'esperienza

• 7-10 anni di esperienza relativa in un analista di sistemi aziendali IT o ruolo di garanzia della qualità IT.

• Forte conoscenza del dominio dell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica, processi di garanzia della qualità e convalida dei sistemi informatici (CSV).

• Una corretta comprensione delle metodologie di sviluppo delle applicazioni (Agile e Cascata), compresi i requisiti funzionali, la modellazione dei processi e le implementazioni di sistema su larga scala.

• Laurea in scienze della vita, informatica, business o equivalente (MA/MS o post-laurea corsi è un plus).

• Ottima comunicazione scritta e verbale, capacità di presentazione e facilitazione.

• Dimostrata capacità di costruire relazioni, concentrarsi sul cliente, e risolvere problemi complessi in ambienti veloci.

• Forte capacità di applicare in modo indipendente strumenti, principi, concetti e tecniche relative a requisiti, dati, usabilità e analisi di processo.

• Capacità di sostenere la responsabilità per esempio, guidare iniziative di miglioramento del processo, e mentore jun

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
The IT Quality Specialist independently manages the end-to-end quality and analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to solving moderately complex business problems. You will lead the analysis of stakeholders needs, drive root cause analysis, and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability across large-scale initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will champion accountability, mentor junior team members, and drive process improvements that align delivered solutions with overarching business goals .

Key Responsibilities

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and UX Designers, to define scope, solutions, constraints, and project risks.

• Manage compliance documentation processes and systems, characterizing business solutions for compliance with internal and external regulations.

• Be accountable for the creation and maintenance of:

• System Risk Assessments and Data Classification Reports.

• User Requirements and Functional/Technical Specifications.

• Validation Plans, Reports, and Registries.

• Requirements Traceability Matrices, Test Plans, and Test Reports.

• Data/Process flow diagrams and training documentation.

• Configure system settings and provide consultation to customers regarding solution enhancements and new implementations.

• Facilitate UAT planning and execution.

• Serve as a trusted partner for Global Privacy, IT Security, and Business Quality teams, maintaining expert-level knowledge of governance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485).

• Drive the resolution of business or systems issues throughout the project lifecycle.

• Enhance the creation and maintenance of compliance documentation (e.g., System Risk Assessments, Validation Plans, Requirements Traceability Matrices) by leveraging AI-driven automation to reduce manual effort while maintaining compliance rigor.

• Implement AI-assisted quality control tools to automate data validation, anomaly detection, and cross-platform consistency checks, ensuring sustained data integrity and adherence to GxP/CSV standards at scale.

• Utilize AI-powered analytical tools to monitor platform performance, proactively identify process bottlenecks, and generate audit-ready compliance metrics.

• Guide the strategic deployment of AI agents within the IT Quality landscape, ensuring that AI-assisted workflows remain compliant by design and effectively support business requirements.

Experience Profile

• 7-10 years of related experience in an IT business systems analyst or IT quality assurance role.

• Strong domain knowledge of the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, manufacturing/quality assurance processes, and computer systems validation (CSV).

• Proven understanding of application development methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), including functional requirements, process modeling, and large-scale system implementations.

• BA/BS degree in life science, informatics, business, or equivalent (MA/MS or post-graduate coursework is a plus).

• Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.

• Demonstrated ability to build relationships, focus on the customer, and solve complex problems in fast-paced environments.

• Strong capability to independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.

• Ability to champion accountability by example, drive process improvement initiatives, and mentor jun

Die Position
Der IT-Qualitätsspezialist verwaltet unabhängig die End-to-End-Qualitäts- und Analyseaufgaben über verschiedene Funktionen hinweg und trägt zur Lösung mäßig komplexer Geschäftsprobleme bei. Sie werden die Analyse der Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder leiten, die Ursachenanalyse vorantreiben und eine umfassende Rückverfolgbarkeit der Anforderungen in großen Initiativen sicherstellen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater treten Sie für Rechenschaftspflicht ein, betreuen Junior-Teammitglieder und fördern Prozessverbesserungen, die gelieferte Lösungen an übergreifenden Geschäftszielen ausrichten.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, darunter Produktmanager, Architekten, Ingenieure und UX-Designer, um Umfang, Lösungen, Einschränkungen und Projektrisiken zu definieren.

• Verwalten Sie Compliance-Dokumentationsprozesse und -systeme und charakterisieren Sie Geschäftslösungen für die Einhaltung interner und externer Vorschriften.

• Seien Sie verantwortlich für die Erstellung und Pflege von:

• Systemrisikobewertungen und Datenklassifizierungsberichte.

• Benutzeranforderungen und funktionale / technische Spezifikationen.

• Validierungspläne, Berichte und Register.

• Anforderungen Rückverfolgbarkeitsmatrizen, Testpläne und Testberichte.

• Daten-/Prozessflussdiagramme und Schulungsunterlagen.

• Konfigurieren Sie die Systemeinstellungen und beraten Sie Kunden in Bezug auf Lösungsverbesserungen und neue Implementierungen.

• Erleichterung der UAT-Planung und -Ausführung.

• Dienen Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Partner für globale Datenschutz-, IT-Sicherheits- und Business-Quality-Teams und pflegen Sie das Fachwissen über Governance-Standards (z. B. DSGVO, CCPA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485).

• Führen Sie die Lösung von Geschäfts- oder Systemproblemen während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus voran.

• Verbessern Sie die Erstellung und Pflege von Compliance-Dokumentationen (z. B. Systemrisikobewertungen, Validierungspläne, Rückverfolgbarkeitsmatrizen), indem Sie die KI-gesteuerte Automatisierung nutzen, um den manuellen Aufwand zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig die Compliance-Strenge beizubehalten.

• Implementieren Sie KI-unterstützte Qualitätskontrolltools, um Datenvalidierung, Anomalieerkennung und plattformübergreifende Konsistenzprüfungen zu automatisieren, um eine nachhaltige Datenintegrität und die Einhaltung der GxP/CSV-Standards in großem Maßstab zu gewährleisten.

• Verwenden Sie KI-basierte Analysetools, um die Plattformleistung zu überwachen, Prozessengpässe proaktiv zu identifizieren und auditfähige Compliance-Metriken zu generieren.

Le spécialiste de la qualité des TI gère de façon indépendante les tâches de qualité et d'analyse de bout en bout pour diverses capacités et contribue à résoudre des problèmes commerciaux modérément complexes. Vous dirigerez l'analyse des besoins des intervenants, stimulerez l'analyse des causes profondes et assurerez une traçabilité complète des exigences dans le cadre d'initiatives à grande échelle. En tant que conseiller de confiance, vous serez le champion de la responsabilisation, mentorez les membres de l'équipe junior et dirigez des améliorations de processus qui harmonisent les solutions fournies avec les objectifs opérationnels globaux.

• Exigences de l'utilisateur et spécifications fonctionnelles/techniques.

• Plans, rapports et registres de validation.

• Exigences Matrices de traçabilité, plans d'essai et rapports d'essai.

• Utiliser des outils d'analyse alimentés par l'IA pour surveiller le rendement de la plateforme, identifier de façon proactive les goulets d'étranglement des processus et générer des mesures de conformité prêtes à l'audit.

• Forte connaissance du domaine de l'industrie pharmaceutique/biotech, des processus de fabrication/assurance de la qualité et de la validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV).

• Compréhension éprouvée des méthodes d'élaboration des applications (Agile et Waterfall), y compris les exigences fonctionnelles, la modélisation des processus et la mise en oeuvre de systèmes à grande échelle.

• Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, en informatique, en affaires ou en équivalent (MA/MS ou cours de troisième cycle est un plus).

• Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale, de présentation et de facilitation.

Questo ruolo è una posizione chiave a livello di ingresso nel nostro team di ricerca e sviluppo Pharma Services, dedicato a supportare soluzioni diagnostiche innovative e terapie molecolari. Chi sei

• Conoscenza di base della morfologia dei tessuti e delle tecnologie diagnostiche basate sui tessuti.

• Dimostrata capacità di pianificare ed eseguire esperimenti di laboratorio, riconoscere i problemi procedurali di base, ed eseguire l'analisi dei dati entry-level .

• Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta con la capacità di riassumere e presentare i dati scientifici in modo efficace.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is a key entry-level position within our Pharma Services Research & Development team, dedicated to supporting innovative diagnostic solutions and molecular therapies . As a member of this team, you will conduct vital laboratory experiments and engage in routine scientific research activities under guided supervision . You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional team members to present research findings, troubleshoot experimental procedures, and support overall laboratory operations .

The Opportunity

The Pharma Services Research Associate is primarily responsible for executing entry-level laboratory experiments and project activities to generate accurate research data . In this role, you will analyze experimental results and maintain high-quality scientific documentation under guided supervision .

• Plan and execute laboratory experiments following established procedures, project plans, and safety guidelines (SHE/OSHA) .

• Assume responsibility for the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of experimental results while maintaining accurate, up-to-date lab notebook documentation .

• Summarize data into tables or figures, analyze results using standard tools, and draw conclusions following detailed instructions .

• Assist with project coordination, study plan preparations, and basic troubleshooting of experimental procedures .

• Prepare and present experimental findings and project updates during internal or external meetings .

• Participate in routine laboratory maintenance and uphold quality and safety standards .

Who you are

• Bachelor’s degree in Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related field (or a Master's degree with no prior experience) .

• Minimum of 6 months of relevant laboratory experience .

• Basic knowledge of tissue morphology and tissue-based diagnostic technologies .

• Demonstrated ability to plan and execute laboratory experiments, recognize basic procedural problems, and perform entry-level data analysis .

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to summarize and present scientific data effectively .

• High attention to detail, strong organizational ability, and the flexibility to multitask and adapt to changing schedules .

• Proficiency in basic computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, and presentation soft ware .

This is an on-site position. Relocation benefits are not approved for this posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Arizona is $51,000 -$80,080. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors p ermitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed in this link.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

• Grundkenntnisse der Gewebemorphologie und gewebebasierte Diagnosetechnologien .

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Laborexperimente zu planen und durchzuführen, grundlegende prozedurale Probleme zu erkennen und Datenanalysen auf Einstiegsebene durchzuführen.

Responsabilità essenziali:

• Assistere il Site Manager in tutti gli aspetti delle operazioni quotidiane in tutte le sedi del sito, tra cui l'ottimizzazione degli spazi per ufficio e l'utilizzo delle attrezzature.

• Sviluppare procedure operative standard (SOP), documentazione operativa e relazioni metriche basate sui dati.

• Supporta la logistica e l'esecuzione per eventi del campus e visite di alto profilo.

• Conformità tecnica e sicurezza
• Assicurarsi che tutti i sistemi di costruzione, strutture e protocolli di sicurezza aderiscano rigorosamente ai codici locali e agli standard Roche Global Engineering.

• Gestione finanziaria e di progetto
• Sviluppare, rivedere e stimare i casi di business e le stime dei costi per progetti di impianti, tra cui attrezzature, installazione, lavoro, materiali e preparazione del sito.

• Gestire il ciclo di vita finanziario e clericale delle spese di struttura, condurre confronti di spesa e benchmarking.

• Controllare il monitoraggio dei pagamenti e il monitoraggio attraverso il sistema Roche Accounts Payable.

• Gestione e prestazioni del fornitore
• Agire come collegamento primario per gli appaltatori esterni per sviluppare ed eseguire piani di strutture.

• Verificare gli ambiti di lavoro del fornitore, controllare le prestazioni degli appaltatori in loco e garantire il completamento tempestivo degli ordini di lavoro e delle attività di costruzione.

• Ottimizzazione strategica e gestione delle modifiche
• Fornire servizi di gestione degli edifici finalizzati al risparmio di costi, massimizzare il ciclo di vita delle attrezzature e ottimizzare l'utilizzo delle strutture.

• Superare la gestione in loco dei servizi di costruzione per mantenere ambienti di lavoro di alta qualità per i dipendenti.

• Mantenere la disponibilità per le operazioni di in-call e di manutenzione di emergenza.

QUALIFICAZIONI REQUISITI/EDUCAZIONE e/o ESPERIENZA:
Istruzione ed esperienza:

• Istruzione: Laurea in Ingegneria o un campo tecnico correlato.

• Esperienza: 3+ anni di esperienza di gestione delle strutture specificamente all'interno di un ambiente di servizi condivisi o di strutture multifunzionali.

• Competenza tecnica: Forte background in Sicurezza, Salute e Ambiente (SHE) e un elevato grado di competenza nei controlli di processo, sistemi di automazione e teoria del controllo generale.

• Comunicazione: La fluidità in inglese (scritto e verbale) è necessaria per collaborare nella regione delle Americhe.

Conoscenza, abilità e abilità:

• Dimostrare un elevato grado di abilità analitiche e di problem solving, con l'accento su questioni molto tecniche relative ai controlli di processo, sistemi di automazione e teoria del controllo generale.

• Forte capacità interpersonali e approccio collaborativo alla risoluzione dei problemi.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. Dimostrare buone abilità interpersonali con la capacità di interagire bene con una varietà di personalità, competenze disciplinari e livelli educativi.

• La competenza nell'elaborazione delle parole, nel foglio di calcolo, nel database, nella gestione dei progetti e nelle applicazioni software di presentazione.

• Buone capacità di organizzazione e di utilizzo del tempo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Essential Responsibilities:

• Operational Oversight & Site Support
• Assist the Site Manager in all aspects of daily operations across site locations, including office space optimization and equipment usage.

• Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational documentation, and data-driven metric reports.

• Support logistics and execution for campus events and high-profile visits.

• Technical Compliance & Safety
• Ensure all building systems, facilities, and safety protocols adhere strictly to local codes and Roche Global Engineering standards.

• Financial & Project Management
• Develop, review, and estimate business cases and cost estimates for facility projects, including equipment, installation, labor, materials, and site preparation.

• Manage the financial and clerical lifecycle of facility expenses, conducting expense comparisons and benchmarking.

• Oversee payment tracking and monitoring through the Roche Accounts Payable system.

• Vendor Management & Performance
• Act as the primary liaison for external contractors to develop and execute facilities plans.

• Review vendor scopes of work, audit onsite contractor performance, and ensure timely completion of work orders and construction activities.

• Strategic Optimization & Amenity Management
• Provide building management services aimed at cost savings, maximizing equipment lifecycle, and optimizing facility usage.

• Oversee onsite management of building amenities to maintain high-quality workplace environments for employees.

• Maintain availability for on-call duties and emergency maintenance operations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS/EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:
Education and Experience:

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a related technical field.

• Experience: 3+ years of Facilities Management experience specifically within a Shared Services or multi-operational facility environment.

• Technical Expertise: Strong background in Security, Health, and Environment (SHE) and a high degree of proficiency in process controls, automation systems, and general control theory.

• Communication: Fluency in English (written and verbal) is required to collaborate across the Americas region.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Demonstrate a high-degree of analytical and problem-solving skills, with emphasis on very technical issues relating to process controls, automation systems, and general control theory.

• Strong interpersonal skills and collaborative approach to problem solving.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrate good interpersonal skills with an ability to interact well with a variety of personalities, discipline skills and educational levels.

• Proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, database, project management, and presentation software applications.

• Good organization and time utilization skills.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORK ENVIRONMENT :
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; sit and to talk, hear or smell. The employee is occasionally required to walk and stoop, or kneel, crouch. The employee must also occasionally lift and/or move up to 5 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
PBAC Operations Engineer - RDT Gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso
Posizione: Pune

Nell’ambito di Roche Digital Technology (RDT), il nostro team Identity and Access Management (IAM) protegge i beni digitali globali dell’organizzazione sviluppando e operando piattaforme di sicurezza sofisticate. Lavoriamo all'avanguardia nella governance dell'identità, nell'autorizzazione a grana fine e nella sicurezza cloud ibrida per supportare gli utenti e i sistemi business-critical in un ecosistema sanitario globale altamente regolamentato.
In qualità di PBAC Operations Engineer nello spazio Identity and Access Management (IAM), sarai parte di un team globale responsabile per la progettazione, l'implementazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita della nostra infrastruttura Policy Based Access Control (PBAC). Potrai svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nella protezione delle nostre informazioni e dei nostri beni spostando oltre i modelli di accesso tradizionali verso un quadro di autorizzazione dinamico e raffinato che supporta la nostra strategia globale Zero Trust . In questo ruolo, sarai il proprietario tecnico dell'infrastruttura PBAC, garantendo che sia scalabile, resiliente e profondamente integrato nell'ecosistema digitale Roche .

L'opportunità

In questo ruolo, si porterà complesse implementazioni PBAC e modellare il futuro di autorizzazione dinamica in tutta la nostra impresa globale . Lo farai:

• Architetto e mantieni i componenti PBAC (PDP/PEP) in un paesaggio globale ibrido per garantire elevata disponibilità, resilienza e prestazioni.

• Condurre la transizione dai primi casi di utilizzo all'adozione a livello aziendale, definendo gli standard organizzativi per l'autorizzazione basata sulla politica.

• Agire come consulente tecnico primario per i proprietari di applicazioni e dati per integrare senza soluzione di continuità i sistemi tramite RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC e LDAP .

• Guidare il passaggio a Policy come Code (PaC) progettando pipeline automatizzate per la versione, il test e la distribuzione di logica di autorizzazione come software .

• Possedere il ciclo di vita tattico della piattaforma, inclusi aggiornamenti di versione, patch di sicurezza, sintonizzazione delle prestazioni continue e gestione dei provider di servizi gestiti esterni (MSPs) .

• Semplificare i processi di onboarding per nuovi asset, garantendo un rigoroso allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza globali, principi di cambiamento ITIL e requisiti normativi come GDPR .

• Bridge il divario tra le capacità del fornitore e i requisiti aziendali interni durante la navigazione di reti di stakeholder complesse in cluster globale.

• Collabora con product manager e sviluppatori per risolvere problemi insolitamente complessi e creare flussi di autorizzazione sicuri e facili da usare.

Chi sei
Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto leader tecnico che combina profonda esperienza IAM con forti capacità di allineamento degli stakeholder . Per eccellere in questo ruolo, si porta:

• Esperienza: 5–9 anni di esperienza in IT/Security, con 4+ anni dedicati a IAM e competenze specifiche in PBAC/ABAC all'interno di ambienti aziendali di grandi dimensioni .

• Istruzione: È richiesto un diploma di laurea in un campo tecnico; è preferito un master o un dottorato.

• Mastery tecnico: conoscenza avanzata di XACML, Policy as Code (PaC), e gestione politica decentralizzata insieme ai protocolli standard IAM (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO e IGA) .

• Development & DevOps: Proficiency in Java o Python per integrazioni personalizzate, abbinate all'esperienza hands-on utilizzando le pipeline Git e CI/CD per la distribuzione sicura del codice.

• Architectural Mindset: Forte advocacy per i principi di Zero Trust, privilegiando le funzionalità off-the-shelf configurabili su build personalizzate per la manutenzione a lungo termine.

• Consulenza e analisi: Proven abil
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
PBAC Operations Engineer - RDT Identity & Access Management
Location: Pune

As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team protects the organization’s global digital assets by developing and operating sophisticated security platforms. We work at the forefront of identity governance, fine-grained authorization, and hybrid cloud security to support users and business-critical systems in a highly regulated global healthcare ecosystem.
As a PBAC Operations Engineer in the Identity and Access Management (IAM) space, you will be part of a global team responsible for the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Policy Based Access Control (PBAC) infrastructure . You will play a critical role in protecting our information and assets by moving beyond traditional access models toward a dynamic, fine-grained authorization framework that supports our global Zero Trust strategy . In this role, you will be the technical owner of the PBAC infrastructure, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, and deeply integrated into the Roche digital ecosystem .

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead complex PBAC implementations and shape the future of dynamic authorization across our global enterprise . You will:

• Architect and maintain core PBAC components (PDP/PEP) across a hybrid global landscape to ensure high availability, resilience, and performance .

• Lead the transition from initial use cases to enterprise-wide adoption while defining organization-wide standards for policy-based authorization .

• Act as the primary technical consultant for application and data owners to seamlessly integrate systems via RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC, and LDAP .

• Drive the shift to Policy as Code (PaC) by designing automated pipelines for versioning, testing, and deploying authorization logic like software .

• Own the tactical lifecycle of the platform, including version upgrades, security patching, continuous performance tuning, and managing external Managed Service Providers (MSPs) .

• Streamline onboarding processes for new assets, ensuring strict alignment with global security standards, ITIL change principles, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR .

• Bridge the gap between vendor capabilities and internal business requirements while navigating complex stakeholder networks across global cluster squads .

• Collaborate with product managers and developers to resolve unusually complex problems and create secure, user-friendly authorization flows .

Who you are
We are looking for an expert technical leader who combines deep IAM expertise with strong stakeholder alignment skills . To excel in this role, you bring:

• Experience: 5–9 years of experience in IT/Security, with 4+ years dedicated to IAM and specific expertise in PBAC/ABAC within large enterprise environments .

• Education: A Bachelor's degree in a technical field is required; a Master's degree or Ph.D. is preferred .

• Technical Mastery: Advanced knowledge of XACML, Policy as Code (PaC), and decentralized policy management alongside standard IAM protocols (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, and IGA) .

• Development & DevOps: Proficiency in Java or Python for custom integrations, paired with hands-on experience using Git and CI/CD pipelines for secure code deployment .

• Architectural Mindset: Strong advocacy for Zero Trust principles, prioritizing configurable off-the-shelf capabilities over custom builds for long-term maintainability .

• Consulting & Analysis: Proven abil

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
PBAC Operations Engineer - RDT Identity & Access Management
Standort: Pune

Als Teil von Roche Digital Technology (RDT) schützt unser Identity and Access Management (IAM)-Team die globalen digitalen Assets des Unternehmens durch die Entwicklung und den Betrieb anspruchsvoller Sicherheitsplattformen. Wir arbeiten an vorderster Front bei Identitäts-Governance, fein abgestimmter Autorisierung und hybrider Cloud-Sicherheit, um Benutzer und geschäftskritische Systeme in einem stark regulierten globalen Gesundheits-Ökosystem zu unterstützen.
Als PBAC Operations Engineer im Bereich Identity and Access Management (IAM) sind Sie Teil eines globalen Teams, das für das Design, die Implementierung und das Lifecycle Management unserer Policy Based Access Control (PBAC) Infrastruktur verantwortlich ist. Sie werden eine entscheidende Rolle beim Schutz unserer Informationen und Vermögenswerte spielen, indem Sie sich über traditionelle Zugangsmodelle hinaus zu einem dynamischen, fein abgestimmten Autorisierungsrahmen bewegen, der unsere globale Zero Trust-Strategie unterstützt. In dieser Rolle sind Sie der technische Eigentümer der PBAC-Infrastruktur und stellen sicher, dass sie skalierbar, belastbar und tief in das digitale Ökosystem von Roche integriert ist.

Die Chance

In dieser Rolle leiten Sie komplexe PBAC-Implementierungen und gestalten die Zukunft der dynamischen Autorisierung in unserem globalen Unternehmen. Sie werden

• Architektur und Wartung von PBAC-Kernkomponenten (PDP/PEP) in einer hybriden globalen Landschaft, um hohe Verfügbarkeit, Widerstandsfähigkeit und Leistung zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie den Übergang von anfänglichen Anwendungsfällen zur unternehmensweiten Einführung und definieren Sie organisationsweite Standards für richtlinienbasierte Autorisierung.

• Handeln Sie als primärer technischer Berater für Anwendungs- und Datenbesitzer, um Systeme nahtlos über RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC und LDAP zu integrieren.

• Betreiben Sie die Umstellung auf Policy as Code (PaC), indem Sie automatisierte Pipelines für die Versionierung, das Testen und die Bereitstellung von Autorisierungslogik wie Software entwerfen.

• Besitzen Sie den taktischen Lebenszyklus der Plattform, einschließlich Versionsupgrades, Sicherheitspatch, kontinuierliches Performance-Tuning und Verwaltung externer Managed Service Provider (MSPs).

• Rationalisierung der Onboarding-Prozesse für neue Assets, Gewährleistung einer strikten Abstimmung mit globalen Sicherheitsstandards, ITIL-Änderungsprinzipien und regulatorischen Anforderungen wie der DSGVO.

• Schließen Sie die Lücke zwischen den Fähigkeiten der Anbieter und internen Geschäftsanforderungen, während Sie komplexe Stakeholder-Netzwerke in globalen Cluster-Squads navigieren.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, um ungewöhnlich komplexe Probleme zu lösen und sichere, benutzerfreundliche Autorisierungsströme zu schaffen.

Wer du bist
Wir suchen einen erfahrenen technischen Leiter, der fundierte IAM-Expertise mit starken Fähigkeiten zur Ausrichtung von Stakeholdern kombiniert. Um in dieser Rolle zu übertreffen, bringen Sie:

• Erfahrung: 5-9 Jahre Erfahrung in IT / Sicherheit, mit 4+ Jahren IAM und spezifische Expertise in PBAC / ABAC in großen Unternehmensumgebungen.

• Ausbildung: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss in einem technischen Bereich ist erforderlich; ein Master-Abschluss oder Ph.D. wird bevorzugt.

• Technische Beherrschung: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse von XACML, Policy as Code (PaC) und dezentrales Richtlinienmanagement neben Standard-IAM-Protokollen (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO und IGA).

• Entwicklung & DevOps: Kenntnisse in Java oder Python für benutzerdefinierte Integrationen, gepaart mit praktischer Erfahrung mit Git- und CI / CD-Pipelines für die sichere Codebereitstellung.

• Architectural Mindset: Starkes Eintreten für Zero Trust-Prinzipien, wobei konfigurierbare Off-the-Shelf-Funktionen Vorrang vor benutzerdefinierten Builds für langfristige Wartbarkeit haben.

• Beratung & Analyse: Proven abil

Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la protection de nos informations et de nos biens en allant au-delà des modèles d'accès traditionnels vers un cadre d'autorisation dynamique et à grain fin qui soutient notre stratégie globale Zero Trust . Dans ce rôle, vous serez le propriétaire technique de l'infrastructure PBAC, en s'assurant qu'elle est évolutive, résistante et profondément intégrée à l'écosystème numérique Roche.

L'opportunité

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des implémentations complexes de PBAC et façonnerez l'avenir de l'autorisation dynamique dans notre entreprise mondiale. Vous:

• Architecte et maintient les composants de base PBAC (PDP/PEP) dans un paysage mondial hybride pour assurer une grande disponibilité, résilience et performance.

• Rationaliser les processus d'embarquement pour les nouveaux actifs, en assurant un alignement strict sur les normes de sécurité mondiales, les principes de changement ITIL et les exigences réglementaires comme le RGPD.

• Combler l'écart entre les capacités des fournisseurs et les besoins opérationnels internes tout en naviguant sur des réseaux d'intervenants complexes entre les équipes mondiales de clusters.

Qui vous êtes
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader technique expert qui combine une expertise profonde IAM avec de solides compétences d'alignement des intervenants. Pour exceller dans ce rôle, vous apportez :

• Expérience : 5-9 ans d'expérience en TI/Sécurité, avec 4 ans et plus dédiés à l'IAM et une expertise spécifique en PBAC/ABAC dans des environnements de grande entreprise.

• Éducation: Un baccalauréat dans un domaine technique est requis; une maîtrise ou un doctorat est préféré.

• Maîtrise technique : Connaissances avancées de XACML, Politique en tant que code (PAC), et gestion décentralisée des politiques aux côtés des protocoles IAM standard (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, IGA).

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Un futuro più sano. E' questo che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. E' questo che ci rende Roche.

A Roche, stiamo sviluppando la prossima generazione di sistemi di sequenziamento. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e ampliando i menu di analisi, stiamo anche ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione del campione alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento di nuova generazione.

Siamo alla ricerca di un talento e altamente motivato Fellow Postdoctoral con un comprovato record di eccellenza nello sviluppo di nuove tecnologie utilizzando materiali avanzati e tecniche di microfabbricazione. Partecipando al nostro System Technology Group, si svolgerà un ruolo importante nella ricerca e sviluppo precoce di nuove tecnologie, dispositivi e strumenti associati alle nostre piattaforme di sequenziamento del DNA di nuova generazione e diagnostica molecolare.

Al centro di questi strumenti sono sistemi microfluidici altamente integrati in grado di automatizzare i flussi di lavoro intricati e gestire la biochimica complessa. Per prepararsi a questi obiettivi ambiziosi, il vostro focus a breve termine coinvolgerà una formazione profonda e pratica con i nostri sforzi fondamentali. Aiuterai con i progetti attuali a padroneggiare la nostra chimica, materiali e metodi, acquisendo competenze critiche nel modo in cui progettiamo, fabbricare, legare, simulare, operare, caratterizzare e risolvere i sistemi e processi complessi.

Questo è un ruolo pratico e interdisciplinare progettato per colmare il divario tra applicazioni biochimiche e strumentazione all'avanguardia. Collaborando a stretto contatto con un team piccolo e agile e l'organizzazione più ampia, risolverete problemi impegnativi, inventare nuove tecnologie, e alla fine avanzare lo stato dell'arte nei sistemi di sequenziamento del DNA.

Per questa posizione è richiesta una lettera di copertura.

Le vostre responsabilità:

• Progettare, fabbricare e assemblare dispositivi personalizzati, apparecchi e pannelli di pane utilizzando vari strumenti di prototipazione rapida, comprese le attrezzature personalizzate.

• Sviluppare e implementare processi di microfabbricazione avanzati, tra cui fotolitografia, deposizione, etching, perforazione, incollaggio e dicing, e utilizzare strumenti di metrologia di precisione per caratterizzare componenti e valutare metodologie di produzione.

• Creare e caratterizzare nuovi materiali e metodologie di incollaggio.

• Testare, caratterizzare e risolvere problemi complessi sistemi e dispositivi fluidi. Sviluppare e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro su questi sistemi, raccogliendo, analizzando e interpretando i dati per guidare il progresso tecnico.

• Generare piani di prova completi, protocolli, relazioni tecniche e rivelazioni di invenzione per documentare i risultati e la metodologia.

• Selezionare, procurare, installare, validare, operare, riparare e mantenere attrezzature laboratorio/fabbricate e strumentazione personalizzata.

Chi sei?
Qualificazioni richieste

• Hai un Ph.D. in Ingegneria dei materiali, Scienza dei materiali, Bioingegneria, Ingegneria meccanica, Ingegneria chimica, Ingegneria elettrica, Fisica applicata, Biofisica, Nanotecnologia, Micro-Systems Engineering, o una disciplina strettamente correlata con una tesi focalizzata sulla soluzione di un problema di biologia chimica o molecolare con l'ingegneria dei materiali intelligenti e tecniche di microfabrificazione avanzate.

• Hai una solida comprensione della fisica, ingegnere
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology using advanced materials and microfabrication techniques. Joining our Systems Technology Group, you will play a major role in the Research and Early Development of new technology, devices, and instruments associated with our next-generation DNA sequencing and molecular diagnostic platforms.

At the heart of these instruments are highly integrated microfluidic systems capable of automating intricate workflows and handling complex biochemistry. To gear up for these ambitious goals, your near-term focus will involve deep, hands-on training with our foundational efforts. You will assist with current projects to master our chemistry, materials, and methods, gaining critical expertise in how we design, fabricate, bond, simulate, operate, characterize, and troubleshoot complex systems and processes.

This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role designed to bridge the gap between biochemical applications and cutting-edge instrumentation. Collaborating closely with a small, agile team and the broader organization, you will solve challenging problems, invent new technology, and ultimately advance the state-of-the-art in DNA sequencing systems.

A cover letter is required for this position.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

• Design, fabricate, and assemble custom devices, fixtures, and breadboards using various rapid prototyping tools, including custom equipment.

• Develop and implement advanced microfabrication processes, including photolithography, deposition, etching, drilling, bonding, and dicing—and utilize precision metrology instruments to characterize components and evaluate manufacturing methodologies.

• Create and characterize new materials and bonding methodologies.

• Test, characterize, and troubleshoot complex fluidic systems and devices. Develop and optimize workflows on these systems while collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to drive technical progress.

• Generate comprehensive test plans, protocols, technical reports and invention disclosures to document findings and methodology.

• Select, procure, install, validate, operate, repair, and maintain lab/fab equipment and custom instrumentation.

Who You Are:
Required Qualifications

• You have a Ph.D. in Materials Engineering, Materials Science, Bioengineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Biophysics, Nanotechnology, Micro-Systems Engineering, or a closely related discipline with a thesis focused on solving a chemical or molecular biology problem with clever materials engineering and advanced microfabrication techniques.

• You have a solid understanding of physics, engineer

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Bei Roche entwickeln wir die nächste Generation von Sequenziersystemen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir auch den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Akzeptanzbarrieren. Von robusten Werkzeugen zur Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für Sequenzierungs-Workflows der nächsten Generation.

Wir suchen einen talentierten und hochmotivierten Postdoktoranden mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung neuartiger Technologien unter Verwendung fortschrittlicher Materialien und Mikrofabrikationstechniken. Bei unserer Systems Technology Group werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Erforschung und frühen Entwicklung neuer Technologien, Geräte und Instrumente spielen, die mit unseren DNA-Sequenzierungs- und Molekulardiagnostikplattformen der nächsten Generation in Verbindung stehen.

Herzstück dieser Instrumente sind hochintegrierte mikrofluidische Systeme, die komplizierte Arbeitsabläufe automatisieren und komplexe Biochemie handhaben können. Um sich auf diese ehrgeizigen Ziele vorzubereiten, wird Ihr kurzfristiger Fokus ein tiefes, praktisches Training mit unseren grundlegenden Bemühungen beinhalten. Sie unterstützen bei aktuellen Projekten, um unsere Chemie, Materialien und Methoden zu beherrschen, indem Sie kritisches Fachwissen darüber erwerben, wie wir komplexe Systeme und Prozesse entwerfen, herstellen, verbinden, simulieren, betreiben, charakterisieren und beheben.

Dies ist eine praktische, interdisziplinäre Rolle, die die Lücke zwischen biochemischen Anwendungen und modernster Instrumentierung schließen soll. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem kleinen, agilen Team und der breiteren Organisation lösen Sie anspruchsvolle Probleme, erfinden neue Technologien und bringen letztendlich den neuesten Stand der Technik in DNA-Sequenzierungssystemen voran.

Für diese Position ist ein Anschreiben erforderlich.

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Entwerfen, fertigen und montieren Sie benutzerdefinierte Geräte, Armaturen und Brotbretter mit verschiedenen Rapid Prototyping-Tools, einschließlich benutzerdefinierter Geräte.

• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie fortschrittliche Mikrofabrikationsprozesse, einschließlich Photolithographie, Abscheidung, Ätzen, Bohren, Kleben und Dicing - und verwenden Sie Präzisionsmessgeräte, um Komponenten zu charakterisieren und Fertigungsmethoden zu bewerten.

• Erstellen und charakterisieren Sie neue Materialien und Bindungsmethoden.

• Testen, charakterisieren und beheben Sie komplexe fluidische Systeme und Geräte. Entwickeln und optimieren Sie Workflows auf diesen Systemen, während Sie Daten sammeln, analysieren und interpretieren, um den technischen Fortschritt voranzutreiben.

• Generieren Sie umfassende Testpläne, Protokolle, technische Berichte und Erfindungsangaben, um Ergebnisse und Methodik zu dokumentieren.

• Wählen, beschaffen, installieren, validieren, betreiben, reparieren und warten Sie Labor- / Fabrikausrüstung und benutzerdefinierte Instrumentierung.

Wer Du bist:
Benötigte Qualifikationen

• Sie haben einen Ph.D. in Materials Engineering, Materials Science, Bioengineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Biophysics, Nanotechnology, Micro-Systems Engineering oder eine eng verwandte Disziplin mit einer Diplomarbeit, die sich auf die Lösung eines chemischen oder molekularbiologischen Problems mit cleverer Materialtechnik und fortschrittlichen Mikrofabrikationstechniken konzentriert.

• Sie haben ein solides Verständnis von Physik, Ingenieur

Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Chez Roche, nous développons la prochaine génération de systèmes de séquençage. En accélérant la recherche clinique, en rationalisant les flux de travail et en élargissant les menus d'essai, nous élargissons également l'accès aux données génomiques et abaissons les obstacles à l'adoption. Des outils d'isolement et de préparation d'échantillons robustes aux nouvelles technologies de séquençage et à la bioinformatique avancée, nous développons des solutions de bout en bout différenciées et hautement intégrées pour le séquençage de prochaine génération.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un boursier postdoctoral talentueux et très motivé ayant fait preuve d'excellence dans le développement de nouvelles technologies à l'aide de matériaux avancés et de techniques de microfabrication. En vous joignant à notre Groupe de la technologie des systèmes, vous jouerez un rôle majeur dans la recherche et le développement précoce de nouvelles technologies, de nouveaux appareils et d'instruments associés à nos plateformes de séquençage et de diagnostic moléculaire de prochaine génération.

Au cœur de ces instruments se trouvent des systèmes microfluidiques hautement intégrés capables d'automatiser les flux de travail complexes et de manipuler la biochimie complexe. Pour vous préparer à ces objectifs ambitieux, votre objectif à court terme consistera à vous entraîner de près avec nos efforts fondamentaux. Vous aiderez les projets en cours à maîtriser notre chimie, nos matériaux et nos méthodes, à acquérir une expertise critique dans la conception, la fabrication, la liaison, la simulation, le fonctionnement, la caractérisation et le dépannage de systèmes et processus complexes.

Il s'agit d'un rôle pratique et interdisciplinaire conçu pour combler l'écart entre les applications biochimiques et les instruments de pointe. En collaborant étroitement avec une petite équipe agile et l'ensemble de l'organisation, vous résoudrez des problèmes difficiles, inventerez de nouvelles technologies et, en bout de ligne, améliorerez les systèmes de séquençage de l'ADN.

Une lettre d'accompagnement est requise pour ce poste.

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités :

• Concevoir, fabriquer et assembler des appareils, des accessoires et des planches à pain personnalisés à l'aide de divers outils de prototypage rapides, y compris des équipements personnalisés.

• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des procédés avancés de microfabrication, y compris la photolithographie, le dépôt, la gravure, le forage, le collage et le tamisage, et utiliser des instruments de métrologie de précision pour caractériser les composants et évaluer les méthodes de fabrication.

• Créer et caractériser de nouveaux matériaux et méthodes de liaison.

• Tester, caractériser et dépanner des systèmes et des dispositifs fluidiques complexes. Développer et optimiser les flux de travail sur ces systèmes tout en recueillant, analysant et interprétant des données pour stimuler le progrès technique.

• Générer des plans d'essais, des protocoles, des rapports techniques et des divulgations d'inventions complets pour documenter les constatations et la méthodologie.

• Sélectionnez, achetez, installez, validez, actionnez, réparez et maintenez l'équipement de laboratoire/fab et les instruments personnalisés.

Qui vous êtes :
Qualifications requises

• Vous avez un doctorat en génie des matériaux, science des matériaux, bioingénierie, génie mécanique, génie chimique, génie électrique, physique appliquée, biophysique, nanotechnologie, génie des micro-systèmes, ou une discipline étroitement liée avec une thèse axée sur la résolution d'un problème de biologie chimique ou moléculaire avec génie des matériaux intelligents et techniques de microfabrication avancées.

• Vous avez une solide compréhension de la physique, ingénieur
